ranked_architectures.name: Islet-1 Universal Chassis A ('Lean 4-Locus Swap-In Core + Biallelic AAVS1-[455bp HNRNPA2B1-proximal candidate (legacy CBX3-A2UCOE)]-EEF1A1-core-iCasp9')
ranked_architectures.graveyard_warn_reconciliation_note: Triggers GRAVEYARD_009 (WARN: resting B2M-promoter Hour-0 surface density deficit) and GRAVEYARD_010 (WARN: MHC-null indirect APC bystander blindspot). In the evaluator, WARN rules apply pre-registered quantitative logit discounts (-0.20 in Gate 3 for GRAVEYARD_009; -0.25 in Gate 2B for GRAVEYARD_010) and attach mandatory Stage-0/Stage-1 Go/No-Go decision gates (Decision Experiment #1 QuantiBRITE flow + Arm 1B 2A-free bidirectional comparison; Decision Experiment #2 HLA-DQ2/DQ8 DC indirect presentation & incremental SA-FasL Delta_TUNEL+ <= +5.0 pp screen) without hard-zeroing the stack (Finding 040).

locus1_and_locus4_engineering_audit_note.locus1_arm1a_vs_arm1b_donor_size_and_del: Arm 1A bicistronic donor (4,880 bp donor / 5,170 bp with ITRs) exceeds the 4,700 bp single-AAV6 packaging limit and requires non-viral linear dsDNA/ceDNA HDR or Bridge-RNA recombinase (PMID:36008610, PMID:38926615, PMID:41642947) while leaving a 21-aa cytosolic -GSG-P2A tail on HLA-E*01:03; Arm 1B scarless 2A-free bidirectional cassette [SV40pA-CD47-IgV-GPI(antisense) <- EEF1A1-core | Syn_5xISRE_minP -> HLA-E*01:03(VMAPRTLVL)-bGHpA] is 3,974 bp donor / 4,264 bp with ITRs (+436 bp headroom below the 4,700 bp single-AAV6 limit) and eliminates all 2A peptide tails (Findings 075, 076, 077).
locus1_and_locus4_engineering_audit_note.hla_e_vmaprtlvl_hcmv_ul40_and_kw_motif_n: VMAPRTLVL matches the HLA-A*02:01 leader and has ~12% sequence overlap with clinical HCMV UL40 isolates (vs ~43% for VMAPRTLIL; Lin et al. 2023 PMID:37264229), reducing but not eliminating NKG2C+ adaptive NK recognition in HCMV-seropositive recipients; Stage-0 Decision Experiment #1 compares WT HLA-E*01:03(VMAPRTLVL) against cytoplasmic tail KW-motif retention-signal removal (He et al. 2025 PMC12582296) across HCMV+ NKG2C+ and NKG2A- KIR2DL1/2/3+ primary NK donors (Finding 078).
locus1_and_locus4_engineering_audit_note.cd47_igv_gpi_vs_dct_ectodomain_note: CD47-IgV-GPI was evaluated in non-islet systems (Jurkat/macrophage phagocytosis, HUVEC angiogenesis, and hematopoietic stem-cell/immunodeficient-mouse assays; Xu et al. 2024 Cell Rep Med PMID:38508139, PMC10983038) rather than mature beta-cells; Stage-0 Decision Experiment #1 compares CD47-IgV-GPI against cytoplasmically truncated transmembrane CD47-dCT and full-length CD47-WT (OA3-323; Ghimire et al. 2023 PMID:37820008 Cdc42/GSIS counter-evidence) for GPI-PLC sensitivity, QuantiBRITE density, and dynamic perifusion GSIS (Finding 079).
locus1_and_locus4_engineering_audit_note.sa_fasl_sa_thbd_immunosuppression_and_fr: Published murine and NHP SA-FasL PEG-microgel studies (Headen et al. 2018 PMID:29867165; Lei et al. 2022 PMID:35559682) included transient short-course rapamycin, whereas Turan et al. 2024 (PMID:38709159) evaluated direct islet surface biotinylation co-displaying SA-THBD (SA-TM) and SA-CD47 in a murine syngeneic intraportal IBMIR/engraftment model without rapamycin and Kazmi et al. 2026 (PMID:41842939) demonstrated immunosuppression-free murine BALB/c->C57BL/6 intraportal allograft survival with direct surface SA-THBD + SA-CD47 (without SA-FasL, PEG microgels, or rapamycin); because IL-1beta sensitizes human beta-cells to Fas (CD95) apoptosis (Loweth et al. 1998 PMID:9588443), Decision Experiment #2 enforces an incremental fratricide kill gate of Delta_TUNEL+ <= +5.0 pp above cytokine-matched SA-THBD-only control AND anti-Fas ZB4 mAb rescue <= 5.0 pp (Finding 080; L3B-01/02/03 [DEC-077]).
locus1_and_locus4_engineering_audit_note.locus4_a2ucoe_xiap_and_smac_salvage_note: Locus 4 uses the 455 bp HNRNPA2B1-proximal candidate (legacy CBX3-A2UCOE alias; insulation function pending) + 250 bp cHS4 insulator driving the 230 bp human EEF1A1 core promoter (3,457 bp donor / 3,747 bp with ITRs <= 4,700 bp single-AAV6 limit; PMID:25605798, PMID:28860464, PMID:23307570, PMID:26455413). Because hypoxia/cytokines upregulate XIAP (BIRC4), which inhibits processed Caspase-9 via its BIR3 domain (Srinivasula et al. 2001 PMID:11242052), Decision Experiment #4 evaluates an unvalidated preclinical salvage hypothesis of co-dosing AP1903 with an IAP antagonist (IV birinapant [PMC4742409] or oral xevinapant [noting Phase III TrilynX termination, doi:10.1200/JCO-25-00272]) (Findings 081, 086).
locus1_and_locus4_engineering_audit_note.step1_step2_sequential_editing_and_biall: Sequential 2-step editing (<=2 loci/step) with orthogonal nucleases (HiFi-SpCas9 + AsCas12a Ultra) and transient i53/RAD51 mRNA targets ~25-40% single-locus biallelic HDR (~6-16% dual-locus biallelic clone yield per step across 96-384 screened clones; Schiroli et al. 2019 PMID:30905619; Kosicki et al. 2018 PMID:30010673; Turchiano et al. 2021 PMID:33626327). In Step 2, targeting Locus 3 (CXCL10, Chr4q21) and Locus 4 (AAVS1, Chr19q13.42) yields N_effective = 2 simultaneously cleaved chromosomal loci (1 heterotypic locus pair), or N_total = 4 diploid alleles (6 allele pairs: 4 inter-chromosomal + 2 homologous sister/homolog pairs) (Findings 028, 082).

edit_stack_specification.edit: B2M-ISRE::[EEF1A1-core + chimeric intron]-HLA-E*01:03(VMAPRTLVL)-GSG-P2A-CD47-IgV-GPI-WPREmut6 (or Stage-0 Pre-Pilot Scarless 2A-Free Bidirectional Arm 1B; Endogenous B2M exon 1 knock-in)
edit_stack_specification.role: Eliminates classical HLA-A/B/C in 1 locus while resolving the C-terminal GPI-signal vs 2A-scar conflict and explicitly accounting for 2A cytosolic tail topology (Audit F-07; Red-Team RT2-02/RT2-03 & RT1-01; Audit R01/R17): for the GPI-anchored construct (Xu et al. 2024 PMID:38508139), places HLA-E*01:03(VMAPRTLVL) 5'-upstream of GSG-P2A (Liu et al. 2017 PMID:28526819) and places CD47-IgV-GPI at the 3' cistron so the 37-aa DAF (CD55) GPI-anchoring signal sequence resides at the true extreme C-terminus without a 21-aa P2A stub blocking ER GPI-transamidase (PIGK) omega-site cleavage (and ER Signal Peptidase SEC11A/C cleaves the N-terminal Pro-SP of CD47-IgV-GPI). Note on membrane topology (Audit R01): because HLA-E*01:03 single-chain trimer is a Type I transmembrane protein whose C-terminal cytoplasmic tail resides in the cytosol (pH ~7.2), whereas Furin (PCSK3) is a trans-Golgi lumenal protease (pH ~6.0, Ca2+-dependent), Furin is omitted and in Arm 1A HLA-E*01:03 retains the 21-aa cytosolic -GSG-P2A peptide tail. To test a completely scarless, read-through-free architecture where neither protein carries a 2A tail, the Stage-0 Construct Pre-Pilot (Decision Experiment #1; GPI-PLC sensitivity + QuantiBRITE flow + anti-2A/anti-HLA-E Western blot) compares (a) Arm 1A bicistronic (4,880 bp donor / 5,170 bp with ITRs, non-viral linear dsDNA/ceDNA HDR per Shy et al. 2023 PMID:36008610 supports a different nonviral editing context; exact ceDNA/Arm 1A delivery in hPSCs remains unvalidated; note that bacterial IS110 Bridge-RNA recombinases in Durrant et al. 2024 PMID:38926615 and Pelea et al. 2026 PMID:41642947 are exploratory and not validated in human iPSCs), (b) scarless 2A-free bidirectional Arm 1B [SV40pA-CD47-IgV-GPI(antisense) <- EEF1A1-core | Syn_5xISRE_minP -> HLA-E*01:03(VMAPRTLVL)-bGHpA] (3,974 bp donor / 4,264 bp with ITRs, single-AAV6 compatible <= 4,700 bp), and (c) transmembrane 5'-CD47-dCT-tPT2A-HLA-E and 5'-CD47-WT(OA3-323)-tPT2A-HLA-E (clinical UP421 benchmark PMID:37156915, PMID:40757665; beta-cell Cdc42/GSIS counter-evidence in Ghimire et al. 2023 PMID:37820008; ~12% VMAPRTLVL overlap with clinical HCMV UL40 isolates in Lin et al. 2023 PMID:37264229; optional cytoplasmic KW-motif per He et al. 2025 PMC12582296).

Eliminates donor HLA-DR/DP/DQ Class II direct CD4+ presentation (gnomAD pLI = 2.0e-14). Paired in Gate 5 with transient biodegradable SA-FasL + SA-THBD microgels (Headen et al. 2018 PMID:29867165; Lei et al. 2022 PMID:35559682; Turan et al. 2024 PMID:38709159; Kazmi et al. 2026 PMID:41842939 — noting that murine and NHP SA-FasL PEG microgels [Headen et al. 2018 PMID:29867165; Lei et al. 2022 PMID:35559682] used transient short-course rapamycin, whereas Turan et al. 2024 [PMID:38709159] tested direct surface SA-THBD + SA-CD47 in a murine syngeneic intraportal IBMIR/engraftment model without rapamycin and Kazmi et al. 2026 [PMID:41842939] tested direct surface SA-THBD + SA-CD47 in mouse BALB/c->C57BL/6 intraportal allografts without SA-FasL, PEG microgels, or systemic immunosuppression, and IL-1beta sensitizes human islet beta-cells to Fas [CD95] apoptosis [Loweth et al. 1998 PMID:9588443], which is gated in Decision Experiment #2 as incremental apoptosis Delta_TUNEL+ <= +5.0 percentage points above cytokine-matched SA-THBD-only control AND anti-Fas ZB4 mAb rescue <= 5.0 pp; L3B-01/02/03 [DEC-077]).

edit_stack_specification.edit: CXCL10::SERPINB9-GSG-P2A-PD-L1 (Inverted-Cistron Endogenous CXCL10 Exon 1 Swap-In, 4,090 bp donor / 4,380 bp with ITRs <= 4,700 bp single-AAV6 limit)
edit_stack_specification.role: Deletes beta-cell CXCL10 chemokine while comparing inverted cistron order SERPINB9-GSG-P2A-PD-L1 against PD-L1-GSG-P2A-SERPINB9 (Red-Team RT2-01, Decision Experiment #3): in the inverted topology, leaderless cytosolic SERPINB9 (PI-9) is translated first on free cytosolic ribosomes and released into the cytosol upon P2A skipping (Liu et al. 2017 PMID:28526819), after which the nascent PD-L1 ER signal peptide (aa 1-18) engages SRP/Sec61 and is cleaved by ER Signal Peptidase (SEC11A/C) after Ala18 to yield mature PD-L1 (aa 19-290) with its native C-terminal cytoplasmic tail (preserving Cys272 S-palmitoylation by DHHC3 [Yao et al. 2019 PMID:30952982] and CMTM6 stabilization [Burr et al. 2017 PMID:28813417], while empirically testing in Decision Experiment #3 whether the 21-aa P2A C-terminal tail on SERPINB9 affects PI-9 Granzyme B inhibition kinetics; Sintov et al. 2022 PMID:36055241; Tanaka et al. 2009 PMID:19641142; Colli et al. 2018 PMID:30269996).

edit_stack_specification.edit: AAVS1-[455bp HNRNPA2B1-proximal candidate (legacy CBX3-A2UCOE)]-EEF1A1-core-iCasp9 Biallelic Safe-Harbor Suicide Switch (3,457 bp donor / 3,747 bp with ITRs <= 4,700 bp single-AAV6 limit)
edit_stack_specification.role: Pan-lineage inducible Caspase-9 safety switch insulated with the 455 bp HNRNPA2B1-proximal candidate (legacy CBX3-A2UCOE alias; insulation function pending) + 250 bp cHS4 chromatin boundary (Muller-Kuller et al. 2015 PMID:25605798; Zhang et al. 2017 PMID:28860464; Pfaff et al. 2013 PMID:23307570) driving the 230 bp human EEF1A1 core promoter with the unvalidated aim of reducing Stage 0->7 epigenetic silencing without bidirectional perturbation of PPP1R12C (Ordovas et al. 2015 PMID:26455413; Wunderlich et al. 2022 PMID:35795779; Yagyu et al. 2016 PMID:27626039). Exact AAV6 packaging ledger (Audit R17 / v0.8.0): 2x145 bp ITRs (290 bp) + 2x600 bp AAVS1 HAs (1,200 bp) + 250 bp cHS4 core insulator + 455 bp HNRNPA2B1-proximal candidate (legacy CBX3-A2UCOE alias; insulation function pending) + 230 bp EEF1A1 core promoter + 9 bp Kozak + 1,191 bp FKBP12(F36V)-DeltaCasp9 + 122 bp SV40 late polyA = 3,457 bp donor / 3,747 bp total with ITRs (+953 bp headroom below the 4,700 bp single-AAV6 packaging limit). Evaluates an unvalidated preclinical salvage hypothesis of co-dosing AP1903 (0.4 mg/kg) with a SMAC mimetic / IAP antagonist (IV birinapant [PMC4742409] or oral xevinapant [noting Phase III TrilynX termination, doi:10.1200/JCO-25-00272]) to displace XIAP (BIRC4) BIR3-domain inhibition of dimerized Caspase-9 in hypoxic/cytokine-stressed grafts (Srinivasula et al. 2001 PMID:11242052; Decision Experiment #4).

counter_evidence_and_residual_risks: Hour-0 Basal B2M Promoter Density & NKG2A- KIR+ NK Subset Gap (Audit §3.1; Red-Team RT1-01/RT2-02): Resting Stage 7 beta-cells have low basal B2M transcription and ~35-45% of human CD56dim NK cells are NKG2A- KIR2DL1/2/3+; addressed by comparing Arm 1A bicistronic B2M-ISRE::[EEF1A1-core+intron]-HLA-E*01:03(VMAPRTLVL)-GSG-P2A-CD47-IgV-GPI-WPREmut6 and Arm 1B scarless 2A-free bidirectional cassette against 5'-CD47(dCT vs WT)-tPT2A-HLA-E and verifying >200,000 CD47 molecules/cell by QuantiBRITE flow on FACS-gated NKG2A- KIR+ NK subsets and HCMV+ NKG2C+ adaptive NK subsets (Decision Experiment #1).

Indirect Allo/Auto-Antigen Presentation, FasL Extrinsic Death & CaO2/Packing Physics (Audit §3.4; Red-Team RT1-02/RT4-01/RT4-02; AUDIT-REF; Findings 051, 056; L3B-01/02/03 [DEC-077/DEC-078]): Addressed without extra genomic cuts by testing transient biodegradable SA-FasL + SA-THBD microgels (SA-FasL PEG microgels [Headen et al. 2018 PMID:29867165; Lei et al. 2022 PMID:35559682, both with transient short-course rapamycin] + SA-THBD [direct islet-surface SA-THBD + SA-CD47 without rapamycin in Turan et al. 2024 PMID:38709159 (syngeneic) and Kazmi et al. 2026 PMID:41842939 (allogeneic)]; gated on cytokine-induced beta-cell Fas fratricide PMID:9588443), hydrophobic PDMS-CaO2 (OxySite) + covalently immobilized Catalase (100-200 U/mg CaO2 = 79,150-158,300 U/pouch input activity, [H2O2] < 5 uM, plus 72-h 5.710 mmol Ca2+ / 11.420 mmol OH- export and CaCO3/Ca(OH)2 pore-patency release gates; Pedraza et al. 2012 PMID:22371586, Montazeri et al. 2016 PMID:26970510, Lenzen et al. 1996 PMID:8720919; R3-SCI-08, R3-SCI-09), isogenic 3:1 iEC:iPericyte iMVFs (de-novo hPSC iMVFs [Wimmer et al. 2019 PMID:30651639] benchmarked against primary adipose MVFs [Aghazadeh et al. 2021 PMID:34480863]; R3-SCI-10), and macro-scale oxygen packing (single-cluster Stage 7 human SC-islet Krogh radius at Delta_pO2 = 15 mmHg and V_max = 0.034 mol/m^3/s is R_crit = 74.6 um [149.2 um diameter] in free saline [alpha*D_free = 2.1e-14 mol/cm/s/mmHg; vs R_crit = 57.8 um / 115.6 um diameter in bulk hydrogel at alpha*D_gel = 1.26e-14 mol/cm/s/mmHg] and R_crit = 67.9 um [135.8 um diameter] under conservative intra-islet diffusivity [alpha*D_islet = 1.742e-14 mol/cm/s/mmHg in Layer 4, where zero-order drop at R = 60 um is 11.71 mmHg], or 92.6 um [185.2 um diameter] at Delta_pO2 = 23 mmHg in free saline vs rat islet 74.6 um at V_max = 0.0524 mol/m^3/s; passive slab <=1,198 IEQ/cm^2 at 2L_slab = 350 um, or H_crit_fixed_sigma <= 139.8 um at fixed 3,000 IEQ/cm^2 [2L_crit_fixed_phi <= 221.2 um at fixed volume fraction phi = 0.1515], or active 72h PDMS-CaO2 inventory of 0.7915 g [791.5 mg / 10.981 mmol] total loaded pure CaO2 [0.4116 g / 52.0% hydrolyzed over 72 h at t_1/2 = 68 h; embedded in 3.166 g / 2.533 g / 1.706 g total PDMS-CaO2 composite mass for Layouts A / B / Design X; delivering 0.4116 g reacted CaO2 at f_72h = 0.45 requires 0.915 g pure CaO2 / 2.033 g composite at 45 wt%, vs 4.635 g pure CaO2 at uncalibrated bulk disk f_72h = 0.0888 or 8.91 g if scaling the full 0.7915 g inventory by 1/0.0888] across 7.00 cm^3 / 200 cm^2).

Why G6PC2-/- and RNLS-/- are excluded from Chassis A Core: G6PC2-/- lowers fasting glucose and risks fasting/exercise hypoglycemia (Bosma 2020 PMID:32569842), while human RNLS-/- iPSC-beta cells exhibited persistent poor dynamic GSIS and higher OCR in MacDonald et al. 2025 Fig. 6 (PMID:39988068).

ranked_architectures.name: Islet-1 Chassis B ('HLA-C-Retained KIR-Matched Superdonor + TYK2-/- + INS Base-Edit Hypothesis', K=6, B=1)

edit_stack_specification.edit: Biallelic KO of HLA-A, HLA-B, CIITA, and TYK2 (retaining 1 recipient-matched HLA-C allele)
edit_stack_specification.role: 4 distinct chromosomal KOs. Retains 1 recipient-matched HLA-C allele (Xu et al. 2019 PMID:30853558) to engage KIR2DL1/2/3 (C1/C2 epitope groups) while TYK2-/- blocks IFN-alpha-induced MHC-I hyper-expression (Chandra et al. 2022 PMID:36289205). Note on leader-peptide genetics: the canonical position -21M vs -21T dimorphism is primarily an HLA-B polymorphism whereas HLA-A and HLA-C typically encode -21M leader peptides (Ramsuran et al. 2018 PMID:29302013), but because HLA-C has ~10-fold lower basal surface expression than HLA-A/B, deleting HLA-A and HLA-B requires empirical verification that the retained HLA-C allele alone stabilizes sufficient surface HLA-E for CD94/NKG2A+ NK inhibition (Lin et al. 2023 PMID:37264229).

Endogenous inflammation-inducible + minimal basal hPGK floor driving SERPINB9 and PD-L1 without viral 2A peptides (Red-Team RT2-04: prevents proteasome/TAP processing of foreign porcine viral 2A peptide neo-epitopes onto retained HLA-C and compensates for TYK2-/- blunting of early IFN-alpha CXCL10 induction; note that because the human eIF4G 5'-leader acts predominantly via cryptic promoter activity rather than a canonical viral IRES in mammalian bicistronic assays [Han & Zhang 2002 PMID:12370285], Northern blot / 5'-RACE transcript integrity or an explicit dual-promoter architecture is required).

edit_stack_specification.edit: Biallelic AAVS1-[455bp HNRNPA2B1-proximal candidate (legacy CBX3-A2UCOE)]-EEF1A1-core-iCasp9 Safe-Harbor Switch (+ 1 INS Leader/DRiP Base Edit, B=1)
edit_stack_specification.role: Pan-lineage A2UCOE-insulated EEF1A1-core-iCasp9 suicide switch (synchronized with Locus 4 of Chassis A, 3,457 bp donor / 3,747 bp with ITRs; PMID:35795779, PMID:25605798, PMID:23307570, PMID:26455413) + INS leader/DRiP base edit to reduce direct presentation of insulin epitopes on the retained HLA-C allele (PMID:42690930, PMID:28263308).

counter_evidence_and_residual_risks: Higher Multiplex Edit Burden (K=6 DSB loci + B=1 base-edit locus): assigned engineering utility discount 0.7149 versus 1.0000 for K=4 Chassis A; physical translocation rates and clonal yield are unmeasured.

Constitutive TYK2-/- Stage 0->7 Endocrine Yield Loss (Chandra et al. 2022 PMID:36289205 Fig. 2i-j): Constitutive TYK2 knockout compromises Stage 5 endocrine precursor emergence via KRAS dysregulation and reduces Stage 7 monohormonal INS+ beta-cell numbers by ~32% (26.9% vs 41.8% INS+ cells in Fig. 6). Stage-specific post-differentiation editing or inducible TYK2 degradation/allosteric TYK2i (BMS-986165) must be compared against constitutive KO.

HLA-C vs HLA-B Signal Peptide & Expression Context (Ramsuran et al. 2018 PMID:29302013; Lin et al. 2023 PMID:37264229): Whereas HLA-B exhibits the canonical -21M/-21T dimorphism and HLA-C typically encodes -21M, deleting HLA-A and HLA-B removes the dominant HLA-A/-21M HLA-B peptide supply and leaves endogenous HLA-E surface stabilization dependent on lower-expression HLA-C and KIR2DL C1/C2 group matching.
Direct & Indirect Presentation of Non-Insulin Autoantigens: Retained HLA-C can still present GAD65, ZnT8, IGRP, and IA-2 peptides if IFN-gamma/JAK1/JAK2 bypasses TYK2-/-.

ranked_architectures.name: Clinical Benchmark 1: Sana UP421 / Hu 2024 HIP (B2M-/- + CIITA-/- + Lentiviral CD47 OE, K=3)
ranked_architectures.edit_accounting_note: Counts 2 targeted CRISPR nuclease DSB knockouts (B2M-/-, CIITA-/-) + 1 semi-random lentiviral CD47 integration as K=3 total genomic modification loci in the uniform search grid; note that under the K<=4 DSB translocation penalty threshold exp(-lambda_K * max(0, K - 4)), both K=2 and K=3 yield manufacturing_locus_penalty_factor = 1.0000, whereas lentiviral insertional mutagenesis risk is tracked separately in Gate 5 safety (Finding 025).
counter_evidence_and_residual_risks: Sole Tier-1 Human Clinical Proof-of-Concept (PMID:40757665; 14-month correspondence follow-up in Carlsson et al. 2026 PMID:42430558, indexed as a zero-weight Project_Summary): Demonstrated C-peptide survival in n=1 human T1D intramuscular forearm sentinel implant (sub-curative sentinel dose) using primary cadaveric islets.
Lacks intrinsic cytokine/granzyme shield (PMID:31900242), pre-vascularized oxygen bridge, or pan-lineage suicide switch required for a 0.8B-cell hPSC-derived pediatric curative dose.

ranked_architectures.name: Clinical Benchmark 3: Unedited SC-Islets (Vertex VX-264 Macrodevice / zimislecel VX-880 with Systemic Immunosuppression, K=0)
ranked_architectures.clinical_modality_separation_note: Separates two distinct unedited SC-islet clinical modalities (Finding 025): (1) Vertex VX-264 (NCT05791201): unedited SC-islets inside a channel-array macro-encapsulation device without systemic immunosuppression (modeled directly by this search-grid combination; clinical program discontinued March 2025 due to insufficient C-peptide across the diffusion barrier); (2) Vertex zimislecel / VX-880 (NCT04786262 / NCT06832410; Reichman et al. 2025 NEJM): naked intraportal infusion of unedited SC-islets achieving insulin independence in 10/12 adult T1D recipients at Day 365, but requiring lifelong systemic calcineurin/mTOR/anti-thymocyte immunosuppression that is contraindicated for the immunosuppression-free pediatric Target Product Profile.
counter_evidence_and_residual_risks: 0 genetic edits (K=0); relies on chronic systemic immunosuppression (zimislecel / VX-880, NCT04786262 / NCT06832410) or a cell-impermeable diffusion membrane (VX-264, NCT05791201, >150 um) that causes central hypoxic necrosis and fibrotic foreign-body reaction.

triggered_graveyard_rules.reason: Clonal STAT1-/- blocks GAS/ISRE promoter induction of PD-L1/SERPINB9 (Sintov 2022 PMID:36055241; Parent 2021 PMID:34407395).
Lineage-restricted (G6PC2::iCasp9) suicide switch fails to ablate dedifferentiated, teratoma, or SLC18A1+ off-target cells (PMID:27626039, PMID:35795779).
Precautionary mechanistic hazard: Biallelic G6PC2-/- shifts the beta-cell glucose dose-response curve leftward and lowers fasting blood glucose (Bosma 2020 PMID:32569842; Overway 2022 PMID:34954144).

exact_rational_parameter_variance_and_vi.algebraic_note_main_effect_block_inflati: Adding the additive stage-block indicator B to the 36-run design changes the main-effect variance multipliers by 0.1387%-5.9132% (X1 0.1387%, X2 0.1387%, X3 0.1387%, X4 0.8875%, X5 5.9132%, X6 0.8875%); exact per-factor values are given below. In the base 34-run design (Runs 01-34) the least-squares projection of B on the 22-column genetic model has coefficient exactly 0 on all six main-effect columns (it loads only on the intercept, 1/16, and on the 15 two-factor interaction columns), so by the partitioned-inverse identity Var_23(b_k) = Var_22(b_k) + c_k^2 / SSR the six main-effect multipliers are identical with and without B (13/224 in both models): exactly 0.0% inflation. The 2 lead-chassis confirmatory replicates (genotype [1, 1, 1, -1, -1, -1], stage 1 only) move that projection onto the main effects (c_k = X1,X2,X3: 3/278; X4,X6: -15/556; X5: -9/139), which is the sole source of the inflation above; in exchange the worst-case 2FI multiplier falls from 335/224 (1.495536) to 1191/1616 (0.737005) and the lead genotype's prediction variance (stage 0 / stage 1) from 33/7 / 47/7 to 191/202 / 47/101 (single observation = 1).

locus1_x1_by_x2_physical_construct_matri.design_identifiability_note: Because X1 = -1 cells are monocistronic (expressing CD47 alone at B2M exon 1) whereas X1 = +1 cells are bicistronic (co-expressing HLA-E*01:03 and CD47 via GSG-tPT2A), the coded X1 main effect and X1:X2 interaction jointly capture HLA-E surface presence plus any monocistronic-to-bicistronic translational stoichiometry shift on downstream CD47. Therefore, every factorial run records absolute QuantiBRITE surface molecules/cell for both HLA-E and CD47 as continuous covariates in a secondary mediation analysis, and Stage-0 Decision Experiment #1 compares the bicistronic tPT2A cassette against a 2A-free bidirectional/dual-promoter cassette (Audit R01/R02).

unit_leverage_diagnostic_and_optional_46.unit_leverage_explanation: In the 29-column exploratory model (23col + 6 B*X_i) on 40 runs, the 6 single-replicate inter-stage bridge rows (Runs 25, 26, 37, 38, 39, 40) have hat leverage h_ii = 1.0000 (whereas in the primary 23-column model on 40 runs max h_ii = 8111/9566 = 0.847899 [and 16180/19049 = 0.849388 in the 24-column Mode-B indicator matrix or 90371537/106195448 = 0.850993 in the 24-column continuous-Z3 polynomial matrix, vs 175/202 = 0.866337 in the 36-run 23-column baseline; S55R2-D1-04] with 0 unit-leverage rows). biological_replication_and_blocking_plan.biological_replicate_unit: Mode 1 (108 Independent Run-Nested Founder Clones): 3 independently derived/edited hPSC founder clones per run across all 36 runs (108 independent founder clone units total, giving diagonal Cov(Y_bar) = sigma_run^2 * I_36). biological_replication_and_blocking_plan.randomization_and_blocking: Option A (Preferred Single-Stage Execution, 22-column model): Execute and randomize all 36 coded run rows, including all 11 repeat/bridge/lead rows (25 distinct genotypes), within shared differentiation and immune-donor blocks. Do not collapse the 36-row information matrix to 25 rows. Option B (Sequential Two-Stage Execution, 23-column model with stage_block_B): Include Runs 25-26 (exact repeats of Tier-1 Runs 01 and 16 inside Tier-2), duplicated Tier-2 Runs 17-24 and 27-34, and the two lead-chassis confirmatory replicates Runs 35-36, giving rank([X | B]) = 23/23 and 0 unit-leverage rows (max h_ii = 175/202 = 0.866337, projection residual SSR = ||(I - H_22) B||_2^2 = 202/139) so inter-stage batch shift B is linearly independent and jointly estimable with all 21 genetic main/interaction effects.

run_to_batch_allocation_and_within_stage.stage0_batch_allocation: Stage-0 Runs 01-16 (plus Run 37 in the 40-run bridge) are differentiated across n_batches = 2 independent Stage 0->7 differentiation batches (Batch S0-A and Batch S0-B), with every Stage-0 run executed in both Batch S0-A and Batch S0-B (complete run-by-batch crossing within Stage 0) so all 6 main effects X1..X6 and 15 2FIs are strictly orthogonal to the within-Stage-0 batch contrast (Batch S0-A vs Batch S0-B).
run_to_batch_allocation_and_within_stage.stage1_batch_allocation: Stage-1 Runs 17-36 (plus Runs 38-40 in the 40-run bridge) are differentiated across n_batches = 2 independent Stage 0->7 differentiation batches (Batch S1-A executing Tier-2 Block A [Runs 17-24], bridge Run 25, and Lead Run 35; Batch S1-B executing exact Tier-2 duplicate Block B [Runs 27-34], bridge Run 26, Lead Run 36, and Runs 38-40), with explicit within-stage batch random-intercept covariance tau_batch^2 * B_batch * B_batch^T included in the REML/GLS mixed model (or eliminated for main effects via complete run-by-batch crossing; under literal S1-A vs S1-B split-batch incidence B_batch * B_batch^T at tau_batch = 2.5 / 5.0 pp, Mode 2 [75 shared-genotype clones across 25 distinct genotypes, Cov = (64/3)*Z*Z^T + v_eps*I + tau^2*B_batch*B_batch^T] gives main-effect GLS SE = [1.2655, 1.3461] / [1.2655, 1.3462] pp, 2FI SE = [1.8054, 4.0872] / [1.8055, 4.0873] pp, and SE(B) = 3.7139 / 5.7046 pp under 2-batch residual v_eps = 49/6 (or main [1.2802, 1.3502] / [1.2802, 1.3503] pp, 2FI [1.9109, 4.5345] / [1.9109, 4.5347] pp, and SE(B) = 4.1258 / 5.9810 pp under 1-batch-per-Stage-1-row residual v_eps = 49/3), whereas Mode 1 [108 independent run-nested clone differentiations, Cov = diag(64/3 + v_eps) + tau^2*B_batch*B_batch^T] gives main-effect GLS SE = [1.2359, 1.3086] / [1.2363, 1.3093] pp, 2FI SE = [1.4499, 4.6648] / [1.4502, 4.6655] pp, and SE(B) = 5.1540 / 6.7319 pp under 2-batch residual v_eps = 49/6 (or main [1.2526, 1.3159] / [1.2530, 1.3167] pp, 2FI [1.5876, 5.0166] / [1.5879, 5.0173] pp, and SE(B) = 5.3910 / 6.9151 pp under 1-batch-per-Stage-1-row residual v_eps = 49/3), as tabulated in differentiation_batch_variance_sensitivity_sweep; S55R2-S2-07, AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).

statistical_analysis_and_power_plan.linear_mixed_effects_model_specification: Y_{ijkd} = x_i^T * beta + u_clone(g(i),j) + b_batch(k) + v_donor(d) + epsilon_{ijkd}, where x_i in R^23 is the coded design row [1, X1..X6, 15 2FIs, stage_block_B], u_clone(g(i),j) ~ N(0, sigma_clone^2) is the random intercept for independently edited hPSC clone j of genotype g(i) (preventing clonal pseudo-replication), b_batch(k) ~ N(0, sigma_batch^2) is the differentiation batch random effect, v_donor(d) ~ N(0, sigma_donor^2) is the PBMC/NK/macrophage donor random effect, and epsilon_{ijkd} ~ N(0, sigma_eps^2) is the residual assay error.
statistical_analysis_and_power_plan.effective_run_level_variance_formula: Defining sigma_eps = 7.0 percentage points (pp) as the donor-averaged clone-by-batch cell residual (averaged across n_donors = 3 immune donors after donor-block centering), averaging over n_clones = 3 clones and n_batches = 2 differentiation batches per run yields effective run-mean variance sigma_run^2 = sigma_clone^2 / n_clones + sigma_eps^2 / (n_clones * n_batches) = 8.0^2 / 3 + 7.0^2 / 6 = 177/6 = 29.50 pp^2 -> sigma_run = 5.43 pp (whereas if 7.0 pp represents the single-donor well residual epsilon_{ijkd}, averaging across n_donors = 3 donors gives sigma_run,3donors = sqrt(8.0^2 / 3 + 7.0^2 / (3 * 2 * 3)) = sqrt(433/18) = 4.90 pp; and single-clone pseudo-replication n_clones = 1 would inflate sigma_run to sqrt(8.0^2 + 7.0^2/2) = 9.41 pp). Both Mode 1 (108 independent run-nested clone differentiations, Cov(Y_bar) = sigma_run^2 * I_36) and Mode 2 (75 shared-genotype clones across 25 distinct genotypes, Cov(Y_bar) = (sigma_clone^2 / n_clones) * Z Z^T + (sigma_eps^2 / (n_clones * n_batches)) * I_36 with exact GLS and OLS sandwich SEs) are reported below.

stage_by_main_29col_expansion.active_tier1_main_effect_columns_note: All 6 main effects (X1..X6) are active and clear of 2FIs in the 16-run Tier-1 screening block (rank 14/22); adding the 8 Tier-2 de-aliasing genotypes + 2 bridge controls (26 runs) or the full replicated 36-run table achieves full rank 22/22 (genetic) and 23/23 (with stage_block_B), whereas the 29-column expansion [I, X1..X6, 15 2FIs, B, B*X1..B*X6] has rank 25/29 (deficiency 4) in the 36-run design, rank 26/29 (deficiency 3) in the 38-run 4-bridge upgrade, and achieves full rank 29/29 with a minimum of 4 extra Stage-1 bridge runs (6 bridges total, 40 runs; e.g. Runs 01, 16, 02, 03, 04, 05) or in the 8-bridge 42-run upgrade (Findings 021, 075, 084).
stage_by_main_29col_expansion.identifiability_note: The two inter-stage bridge genotypes (Runs 01/25 and Runs 16/26) together with the Stage-1 de-aliasing and lead runs (Runs 17-24, 27-36) jointly identify the additive stage shift B (where genetic columns X1..X6 and 15 2FIs use {-1, +1} coding [full High-minus-Low contrast = 2*beta_j] while stage_block_B uses 0/1 indicator coding [0 = Stage 0 Runs 01-16, 1 = Stage 1 Runs 17-36, so beta_B is already the full Stage-1 minus Stage-0 shift], giving rank([X | B]) = 23/23 and projection residual SSR_B = ||(I - H_22) B||_2^2 = 202/139 = 1.4532 in 0/1 stage indicator coding [Var(beta_B) = 139/202 * sigma^2 = 0.688119 * sigma^2, SE(beta_B) = 0.8295 * sigma, MDE(beta_B) = 2.514 * sigma at df=13]; note that the two matched inter-stage bridge pairs alone contribute 1.0000 of the 1.4532 SSR_B in 0/1 indicator coding [68.81% of precision, with the remaining 63/139 = 0.4532 from the 18 non-bridge Stage-1 runs (Runs 17-24, 27-36); in {-1, +1} stage coding where B_pm = 2*B_01 - 1, SSR_B_pm = 4*SSR_B = 808/139 = 5.8129 with bridge sum 4.0000]), whereas adding all 6 stage x main-effect terms B*X1..B*X6 yields 29 columns with exact rank 25/29 (identifiability of the 23-column model assumes genetic main effects and 2FIs are invariant across Stage 0 and Stage 1 blocks, or requires concurrent single-stage blocking / >=6 bridge genotypes in a >=40-run design; AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).

stage_block_B.coding_convention_note: stage_block_B (column 23) is coded as a 0/1 indicator (0 = Stage 0 Runs 01-16, 1 = Stage 1 Runs 17-36), so beta_B is already the full Stage-1 minus Stage-0 block difference (Var(beta_B) = 139/202 * sigma^2, SE(beta_B) = 0.8295 * sigma = 4.5055 pp, MDE(beta_B) = 2.514 * sigma = 13.66 pp at df=13); the 2x multiplier fields in _se_mde_entry apply only if stage_block_B is rescaled to {-1, +1} half-effect coding (AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).

mode2_75_shared_genotype_clones_across_2.allocation_description: 75 independently edited hPSC clones (3 clones per each of the 25 distinct genotypes), where each run cell averages n_batches = 2 independent differentiation batches per run (giving v_eps_run = sigma_eps^2 / (n_clones * n_batches) = 49/6 pp^2 and diagonal run variance 29.50 pp^2 -> sigma_run = 5.43 pp; note that if each run were a single differentiation batch n_batches = 1 with bridged/replicated runs 25-26, 27-34, 36 serving as the second batch for those 11 genotypes, single-batch unbridged runs would have v_eps_run = 49/3 pp^2 -> sigma_run = sqrt(113/3) = 6.14 pp). Here Cov(Y_bar) = (sigma_clone^2 / n_clones) * Z Z^T + (sigma_eps^2 / (n_clones * n_batches)) * I_36: shared clone random effects cancel inside the inter-stage bridge contrasts (cutting stage_block_B SE from 4.51 pp [Mode 1 i.i.d.] to 2.75 pp [Mode 2 GLS] / 3.67 pp [Mode 2 OLS sandwich]) while slightly increasing genetic SEs relative to 108 independent clones.

two_sided_t_test_df10_ncp_2_887.note: In the Stage-2 microfluidic organ-on-a-chip validation (n = 6 independent microfluidic channels per arm, two-sample t-test df = 10, exact noncentrality parameter delta = 1.67 * sqrt(3) = 2.892525), n = 6 channels per arm achieves 85.18% exact noncentral-t power at a pre-registered one-sided alpha = 0.05 (85.18% at two-sided alpha = 0.10, t_crit = 1.81246), whereas two-sided alpha = 0.05 (t_crit = 2.22814) yields 74.13% exact noncentral-t power (69.9% under conservative normal-quantile approximation) and requires n = 7 channels per arm (df = 12, exact power = 81.78%) or n = 8 channels per arm on symmetric 2x4 chip layouts (df = 14, exact power = 87.36%) to exceed 80% two-sided power (Finding 028, AUDIT-REF, & S55R2-S2-08).

statistical_analysis_and_power_plan.multiplicity_and_gate_decision_rule: Co-primary gate endpoints (Gate 1 dynamic GSIS SI >= 3.0 & shut-off <= 3.0 min; Gate 3 NK/macrophage specific lysis <= 10%; Gate 2A/2B autoreactive/allo CTL lysis <= 10%) are evaluated via hierarchical gatekeeping (Gate 1 viability/maturation gate first, followed by Benjamini-Hochberg FDR control at q = 0.10 across the 6 main effects and 15 two-factor interactions).

constant_isogenic_backbone.cell_source: Isogenic human Stage 7 tri-hormonal (60% beta, 30% alpha, 10% delta) SC-islet clusters (<= 120 um diameter)
fixed_edits: Biallelic AAVS1-[455bp/0.7kb CBX3-A2UCOE]-EEF1A1-core-iCasp9 (or AAVS1-CAG-iCasp9; Locus 4 pan-lineage safety switch)
constant_isogenic_backbone.dosing_unit: Two-Step Lineage Purification & Tri-Hormonal Re-Aggregation Workflow: Step 1 (Live-Cell Surface Sorting): Stage 7 SC-islet cultures (after Stage 7 week 0 [S7w0] Aurora kinase inhibitor ZM447439 pulse to suppress off-target enterochromaffin proliferation; Balboa et al. 2022 PMID:35241836) are dissociated and purified without fixation/permeabilization via live-cell surface MACS/FACS into beta-like cells (CD49a+/ITGA1+ live-cell enrichment per Veres et al. 2019 Nature PMID:31068696, which achieves <=80% beta-cell purity with <5% enterochromaffin cells, co-evaluated with adult beta-cell ectonucleotidase NTPDase3+/ENTPD3+ per Saunders et al. 2019 Cell Metab PMID:30449685 and CD9- negative selection per Li et al. 2020 PMID:33096048), alpha-like cells (CD26+/DPP4+ / CD49a-, excluding CD49a+ beta and polyhormonal cells, validated by intracellular GCG+ QC aliquot), and delta-like cells (validated by intracellular SST+ QC aliquot). Step 2 (60:30:10 Pre-Aggregation Input Seeding & Standardized 1,600-Cells/IEQ Volumetric Dosing): Using the unified conversion 1 IEQ (150 um sphere equivalent = 1.77x10^6 um^3) = 1,600 endocrine cells (matching 500,000 IEQ = 8.0x10^8 cells at curative scale), purified live endocrine subsets are seeded at a pre-aggregation input ratio of 1.2x10^6 beta : 6.0x10^5 alpha : 2.0x10^5 delta cells per 1,000 IEQ batch (2.0x10^6 total input cells before ~20% AggreWell re-aggregation/handling loss, yielding ~1.6x10^6 viable aggregated endocrine cells per 1,000 IEQ distributed across ~1,950 uniform <=120 um diameter spheroids of ~820 cells/spheroid) and dosed at 1,000 IEQ (1.6x10^6 cells) per assay well. A matched fixed/permeabilized destructive QC aliquot from each re-aggregated batch is stained intracellularly for NKX6-1+/C-peptide+/INS+ (BD clone R11-560), monohormonal GCG+/C-peptide-, SST+, and intracellular SLC18A1+ (VMAT1+) so exact viable beta-cell count per 1,000 IEQ is recorded as a continuous covariate alongside per-beta-cell normalized secondary readouts.

staged_protocol_clauses: 1. Dedicated post-washout conditioned-medium harvest from the materialised lead and a named matched parental or package-minus comparator under resting and one planned inflammatory condition, documenting viable input, conditioning time/volume, and maintained product PD-L1 state without reusing protease-challenge supernatant or antigen lysate.

2. Minimally processed cell-free effluent with a verified cell-free collection boundary and qualified clarification/filtration and matrix recovery for biologically relevant carrier forms so a fixed 0.45-um filter does not silently remove membrane/vesicle carriers.

3. One validated independently stimulated PD-1-responsive assay with stimulation/medium controls, matched control effluent, responder viability, active anti-PD-L1 blockade vs isotype (measured in blanks, control effluent, and lead effluent), and a form-relevant functional positive reference recovered through the actual processing train, reported as functional effects with uncertainty across independent preparations rather than inferred ng/mL PD-L1 equivalents.

4. Inflammatory cytokine carryover quantification and lot-matched cytokine-spiked unconditioned blanks (plus neutralisation or source/receiver controls where needed), reporting anti-PD-L1 rescue as PD-L1-pathway-dependent activity until receiver/accessory-cell PD-L1 induction and product-side source attribution are resolved.

5. Staged follow-up rule: a reproducible, source-attributed positive directs one decision-limiting follow-up (primary-human responder, carrier attribution, or extra-graft concentration-time bound); a sensitive controlled negative deprioritises further work within the tested product, state, processing method, and exposure bound; failed recovery, insensitive responder, carryover, or induction decay remains unresolved and triggers targeted calibration.

alias_structure.dealiasing_note: In the 16-run 2^(6-2)_IV screening block alone (Runs 01-16), the 22-column second-order model matrix has rank 14/22. Adding an unbridged 8-run block in a separate batch (Runs 01-24 with B) gives rank 22/22 genetic but 22/23 with the stage block, i.e. B is linearly dependent on the 2FIs, and every augmentation row has leverage 1. Therefore the 20-run Tier-2 block (Runs 17-36) includes 2 inter-stage bridge repeats of Tier-1 Runs 01 and 16 (Runs 25-26), duplicated Tier-2 de-aliasing runs (Runs 17-24 and 27-34) and 2 lead-chassis confirmatory replicates (Runs 35-36), achieving full rank 22/22 on genetic effects (max h_ii = 959/1112, trace = 22), full rank 23/23 with the stage-block column B (max h_ii = 175/202, trace = 23; projection residual SSR = 202/139), and 0 unit-leverage rows (leverage groups are listed in exact_rational_leverage_profile_with_stage_block_23cols).

whole_product_clonogenic_safety_model.model_status: Conditional_Preclinical_Safety_Target_Specification (Stage 3 entry gate; NOT demonstrated clinical safety)
whole_product_clonogenic_safety_model.patient_level_target_justification: Targets <10^-3 per-patient probability of any prodrug-resistant clonogenic escape across a full curative pediatric dose (lambda = N_prolif * p_escape = 8.0e4 * 1.0e-8 = 8.0e-4 under independent single-cell escape, bounded below by the non-i.i.d. common-mode floor).
whole_product_clonogenic_safety_model.effective_denominator_definition: Effective detectable clonogenic opportunities (N_prolif = 8.0e4 Ki-67+/SOX9+/OCT4+ residual proliferating cells capable of colony formation across undifferentiated, ductal/progenitor, and off-target states, plus <10^-6 TRA-1-60+/OCT4+ gating on both endocrine and iEC/iPericyte vascular streams), NOT total post-mitotic endocrine cells dispensed (8.0e8) or total living cells dispensed (9.335e8 = 8.0e8 endocrine + 1.335e8 iEC/iPericytes; R3-SCI-01, R3-SCI-02).

pan_lineage_proliferating_cell_budget_so.note: Explicitly accounts for both the 8.0e8 endocrine cell stream (80,000 residual proliferating cells at f_prolif <= 10^-4) and the 1.335e8 vascular iEC/iPericyte stream (13,350 residual proliferating cells if f_prolif <= 10^-4, or 93,350 total pan-lineage clonogenic opportunities per 9.335e8-cell graft): at p_escape <= 1.0e-8, pan-lineage Poisson hazard is lambda_total = 93,350 * 1.0e-8 = 9.335e-4 < 1.0e-3 (P(>=1 escape) = 0.0009331), keeping P_escape_total = q + (1 - q)*r_iid <= 1.0e-3 requires q <= (10^-3 - r_iid)/(1 - r_iid) = 0.0000669981 (~6.70e-5, vs 6.696e-5 under linear union-bound subtraction), and achieving N_eff = 299,573,227.36 effective clonogenic opportunities at empirical spike-in detection efficiency eta_detection = 0.334 requires plating N_input = 299,573,227.36 / 0.334 = 896,925,831 (~8.97e8) physical clonogenic cells across cumulative MCB qualification lots (AUDIT-REF & S55R2-D1-05).

master_cell_bank_pooled_validation.joint_confidence_and_pan_lineage_scope_q: Reconciles exact vs rounded denominators and qualification scope (AUDIT-REF & S2-L1-06): (1) N_eff = -ln(0.05)/10^-8 = 299,573,227.36 effective clonogenic opportunities yields p_95 = 1.0000e-8 and requires ceil(299,573,227.36 / 0.334) = 896,925,831 physical cells at nominal eta = 0.334 (whereas literal rounded N_eff = 300,000,000 yields p_95 = 9.9858e-9 and requires ceil(300,000,000 / 0.334) = 898,203,593 physical cells); (2) in the 50/150 = 0.333333 empirical spike-in calibration, the one-sided 95% Clopper-Pearson lower bound is eta_L95 = Beta_inv(0.05; 50, 101) = 0.269610 (requiring ceil(299,573,227.36 / 0.269610) = 1,111,135,446 physical cells if propagating eta_L95, with Bonferroni/union-bound simultaneous confidence >= 90% across two independent 95% bounds or >= 85% across three); (3) because StemFlex + AP+ colony counting specifically assays residual hPSCs, pan-lineage N_prolif = 93,350 qualification additionally requires parallel post-AP1903 proliferative recovery screening of the 13,350 vascular iEC/iPericyte stream in EGM-2/pericyte medium with CD31+/CD144+/PDGFRB+/EdU+ readout; (4) N_prolif = 93,350 represents the implant-time residual Ki67+ clonogenic pool (requiring pre-implant biallelic iCasp9 verification so post-engraftment vascular/stromal turnover cannot expand an unswitched clone).

quantitative_common_mode_failure_floor.formula: P_escape_total = q_common_mode + (1 - q_common_mode) * r_iid (bounded above by min(1, r_iid + q_common_mode))
quantitative_common_mode_failure_floor.scenario_assumption_status: Illustrative conditional engineering scenario assumptions (NOT empirically measured clinical failure frequencies). When endocrine-only r_iid = 1 - (1 - 10^-8)^(8e4) = 7.9968e-4, keeping P_escape_total = q + (1 - q)*r_iid <= 1.0e-3 requires q <= 2.005e-4; when pan-lineage r_iid = 1 - (1 - 10^-8)^(93,350) = 9.33064516e-4 (including 13,350 vascular iEC/iPericyte proliferating cells), keeping P_escape_total <= 1.0e-3 requires exact q <= (10^-3 - r_iid)/(1 - r_iid) = 0.000066998080 (~6.70e-5, where rounded-up 6.70e-5 gives P_escape_total = 0.0010000019 and linear union-bound subtraction gives 6.6935e-5; plating N_eff = -ln(0.05)/10^-8 = 299,573,227.36 effective cells at point-estimate eta = 0.334 requires 896,925,831 physical cells [or N_eff / eta_95_lower when propagating the Clopper-Pearson lower 95% confidence bound on the 50/150 spike-in recovery], whereas literal N_eff = 300,000,000 requires 898,203,593 physical cells, and if non-proliferating Stage-7 cells do not form colonies in the clonogenic assay then N_eff denominators count MACS-enriched proliferating/Ki67+ cells plated rather than bulk post-mitotic beta cells). Crucially, q_max = 6.70e-5 is a conditional preclinical risk-budget parameter (proving q_common <= q_max via non-parametric zero-failure batch testing 1 - 0.05^(1/n_batches) <= q_max would require ceil(ln(0.05)/ln(1 - 0.000066998080)) = 44,713 independent differentiation batches at exact unrounded q_max, or ceil(ln(0.05)/ln(1 - 6.70e-5)) = 44,711 batches at literal rounded 6.70e-5), and the Stage-0 5-aza-dC / BCL2L1 spike-in assay is a mechanistic positive-control challenge rather than an empirical prevalence bound on q_common (AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).
quantitative_common_mode_failure_floor.note: Even when i.i.d. per-cell escape is <=10^-8, shared batch-level promoter methylation, pre-differentiation clonal mutation, or avascular prodrug under-exposure creates a non-i.i.d. common-mode floor unless mitigated by unlinked dual-locus insertion and post-differentiation QC.

common_mode_silencing_and_en_bloc_surgic.per_graft_vs_per_cell_common_mode_distin: Layer-1 q_common_mode <= 6.6998e-5 is the per-graft/per-batch catastrophic failure probability in P_escape_total = q_common_mode + (1 - q_common_mode)*(1 - (1 - p_cell)^93350), which at q_common_mode = 6.6998e-5 matches the 10^-3 total dose-level ceiling when per-cell escape is at the two-independent-allele floor p_cell = p_ind^2 = 10^-8 (leaving remaining cell-level headroom p_cell <= 1.00000094e-8, i.e. p_common_cell <= 9.4e-16 when q_common_mode = 6.6998e-5 is simultaneously active, whereas under a pure cell-level budget q_common_mode = 0 the 10^-3 dose-level ceiling allows p_cell <= 1.0718e-8, i.e. per-cell p_common_cell <= 7.18e-10; DEC-078); if per-cell trans-epigenetic/XIAP resistance is p_common_cell in [10^-6, 10^-5] (Layer 2), expected surviving proliferating cells per 93,350-cell dose are E = [0.0943, 0.9344] and Poisson dose-level escape probability is P(>=1 survivor) = 1 - exp(-E) = [8.9975%, 60.7192%] (90x-607x above 10^-3; AUDIT-REF [DEC-046/DEC-078]).
common_mode_silencing_and_en_bloc_surgic.en_bloc_surgical_pouch_retrievability_ga: Positions iCasp9 + AP1903 as a high-depth pharmacological debulking switch (>= 4-5 log reduction, tested across N_eff >= 299,573,228 effective clonogenic trials with explicit k = 0 surviving colonies in Stage-0 Gate S9) paired with primary mechanical containment and en-bloc surgical retrievability of the dual pre-vascularized omental pouches (Gate 0S-Retrieval), so patient safety does not rely solely on extrapolated 10^-8 two-allele independence in the presence of cell-wide trans-acting epigenetic silencing or XIAP/BCL-xL apoptotic resistance (AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF [DEC-044/DEC-046]).

non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.description: Note on mechanism (Audit A05): Once suicide cassettes are biallelically integrated at both AAVS1 (PPP1R12C Chr19q13.42) alleles, ordinary homologous mitotic recombination or loss of a single 19q arm does NOT simultaneously eliminate both cassettes. Loss of both copies at a single locus instead requires either (a) LOH/arm loss acting on a subclone that originally received only a monoallelic integration, or (b) sequential second-hit focal deletion/frameshift/silencing of the remaining allele during master cell bank expansion.
non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.mitigation: Verify 100% biallelic integration in single-cell-derived master cell bank clones by digital droplet PCR (ddPCR) + long-read sequencing across Chr19q13.42; if sequential two-hit escape exceeds 10^-8 in expanded MCBs, escalate to the K=5 dual-safe-harbor architecture adding a second unlinked cassette at GAPDH-P2A-iCasp9 (Chr12p13.31).

non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.description: Correlated de novo DNMT3A/3B methylation during 35-day Stage 0->7 differentiation can silence both copies of a viral CAG promoter at AAVS1 (Ordovas et al. 2015 PMID:26455413).
non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.mitigation: Replace viral CAG with a 455 bp HNRNPA2B1-proximal candidate (function pending; published 0.7 kb CBX3-A2UCOE is a different element) + native human EEF1A1-core promoter (230 bp, 19 CpGs, 60.0% GC) flanked by cHS4 insulators (Muller-Kuller et al. 2015 PMID:25605798; Pfaff et al. 2013 PMID:23307570; Zhang et al. 2017 PMID:28860464) and require 60-day post-differentiation + inflammatory cytokine (IFN-g/TNF-a/IL-1b) challenge before AP1903 clonogenic escape testing (adjusting the zero-event upper 95% bound by empirical colony-forming plating efficiency).

non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.description: Because AP1903 chemically dimerizes iCasp9 in the cytosol, bypassing an upstream requirement for mitochondrial outer membrane permeabilization (MOMP) to initiate procaspase-9 activation (though downstream caspase-3 feedback can still recruit mitochondrial amplification and Smac/DIABLO release; Yuan et al. 2022 PMID:35013114, Guerrero et al. 2012 PMID:23539542), upregulation of X-linked inhibitor of apoptosis protein (XIAP / BIRC4) in hypoxic or cytokine-stressed grafts can bind the exposed ATPF tetrapeptide of cleaved Caspase-9 via its BIR3 domain and arrest executioner Caspase-3/7 activation (Srinivasula et al. 2001 Nature PMID:11242052; Red-Team RT3-03).
non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.mitigation: Test Decision Experiment #4 clonogenic escape under combined 1% O2 hypoxia + IFN-g/TNF-a/IL-1b (XIAP-high state) and evaluate the unvalidated preclinical salvage hypothesis of co-dosing AP1903 (2 x 0.4 mg/kg) with a SMAC mimetic / IAP antagonist (IV birinapant [PMC4742409] or oral xevinapant [noting Phase III TrilynX termination, doi:10.1200/JCO-25-00272]) to displace XIAP from iCasp9.

non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.description: Krogh oxygen diffusion (R <= 60 um < R_crit = 74.6 um conservative rat islet benchmark [149.2 um diameter at V_max = 0.0524 mol/m^3/s] and < R_crit = 92.6 um Stage 7 human SC-islet benchmark [185.2 um diameter at V_max = 0.034 mol/m^3/s]; Finding 056) prevents central anoxic necrosis but does not by itself prove uniform lipophilic AP1903 dimerizer pharmacokinetic penetration into fibrotic or poorly perfused in vivo graft pockets.
non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.mitigation: Empirically validate 2-dose AP1903 (2 x 0.4 mg/kg, 48h apart) mass-spectrometry tissue penetration and >99.99% bioluminescent/histological graft clearance in vascularized in vivo sentinel grafts.

non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.description: Cas9 DSBs trigger p53-dependent arrest/apoptosis in 80-95% of wild-type hPSCs (Ihry et al. 2018 PMID:29892062; Haapaniemi et al. 2018 PMID:29892067), strongly selecting for pre-existing dominant-negative TP53 mutations (Merkle et al. 2017 PMID:28445466) and sub-karyotypic Chr20q11.21 (BCL2L1/BCL-xL) copy-number gains (Avery et al. 2013 PMID:24286026; Red-Team RT3-01).
non_iid_common_mode_failure_gates.mitigation: Execute K=4 editing as a 2-step sequential workflow (<=2 loci/step using orthogonal HiFi-SpCas9 + AsCas12a Ultra with transient i53/RAD51 mRNA HDR enhancement; Schiroli et al. 2019 PMID:30905619; in each step, N_effective = 2 chromosomal loci are cleaved simultaneously [1 heterotypic locus pair], corresponding to N_total = 4 diploid alleles [4 inter-chromosomal + 2 homologous allele pairs]; Finding 028) and enforce 3-timepoint longitudinal QC (Seed -> MCB -> Stage 7 EOPC): error-corrected duplex sequencing of TP53/PPM1D/BCOR (noting that 2,000x duplex depth yields only 1 - exp(-0.2) = 18.1% single-molecule sensitivity at VAF = 10^-4, whereas >=95% single-molecule sensitivity at VAF = 10^-4 requires >=29,956 independent duplex molecules [>=30,000x target-enriched duplex depth, and >=62,958 duplex molecules (~63,000x depth) for >=95% power to observe >=3 mutant duplex molecules, vs 87.5% power at 50,000x; Finding 082]), Chr20q11.21 (BCL2L1) ddPCR (CN = 2.00 +/- 0.15 [1.85, 2.15]), functional Nutlin-3a p53 transcriptional response (10 uM Nutlin-3a 8-h p21/CDKN1A and MDM2 mRNA fold induction >= 5.0x; obs_nutlin3a_p21_mdm2_fold_induction >= 5.0), 15-25 kb long-read ONT/PacBio + +/-50 kb flanking SNP LOH phasing (Kosicki et al. 2018 PMID:30010673), and CAST-Seq translocation assay (Turchiano et al. 2021 PMID:33626327).

unconditional_patient_level_tumor_harm_a.conditional_scenario_bound_not_unconditi: This equation is a conditional scenario bound under parameterized post-gate residual fractions; because 20q11.21/BCL2L1 amplification, partial pluripotency retention, and iCasp9/AP1903 apoptosis resistance are mechanistically coupled along the mitochondrial MOMP/XIAP axis (Avery et al. 2013 PMID:24286026), Stage-0 Gate 0S directly measures the coupled joint survival probability empirically via the post-stress 20q11.21 outgrowth assay (obs_post_stress_20q11_bcl2l1_outgrowth_fold <= 1.0) and the sorted hazard-state proliferative clonogenic assay (0/299,573,228 colonies under pulsed human-PK AP1903 monotherapy; MW-R6-S2-01 & MW-R6-S1-02 [DEC-053]).
unconditional_patient_level_tumor_harm_a.unconditional_patient_level_harm_equatio: P_harm_conditional_post_ablation = 1 - (1 - P_escape_given_AP1903) * (1 - p_20q11_bclxl_resistant_clone) * (1 - p_untriggered_extragraft_metastasis * (1 - f_en_bloc_retrieval_completeness)); Extended dose-level scenario bound: P_harm_dose = 1 - (1 - P_untriggered_intragraft_teratoma * (1 - P_clinical_detection_and_ablation)) * (1 - P_triggered_post_ablation_escape_with_mosaic_20q11) * (1 - p_untriggered_extragraft_metastasis * (1 - f_en_bloc_retrieval_completeness))
unconditional_patient_level_tumor_harm_a.pre_vs_post_retrieval_metastasis_term_re: True pre-retrieval dose-level harm without any retrieval discount on extragraft dissemination (under E[N_PSC,endo] = 8.0 and 1% 20q11.21 mosaic at 10,000x AP1903 resistance, q_esc = 0.01 * 1e-4 + 0.99 * 1e-8 = 1.0099e-6) is 1 - (1 - 8.0792e-6) * (1 - 1e-6) = 9.0792e-6; when the 99% en-bloc retrieval factor (1 - f_ret = 0.01) is applied to the 1e-6 extragraft dissemination term (1e-8 residual dissemination), pre-explant intragraft escape + residual dissemination is 1 - (1 - 8.0792e-6) * (1 - 1e-8) = 8.0892e-6, post-99%-explant intragraft escape alone is 8.0792e-6 * 0.01 = 8.0792e-8, and combined post-99%-explant escape plus residual dissemination is 1 - (1 - 8.0792e-8) * (1 - 1e-8) = 9.0792e-8 (whereas 0.01 * 8.0892e-6 = 8.0892e-8 would double-discount the 1e-8 dissemination term by (1 - f_ret)^2; at whole-product E[N_PSC,whole] = 9.335, P_pre = 1.0427e-5 and P_post = 1.0427e-7, and at the illustrative pre-Tier-A intermediate whole-product bound f_PSC = 1e-7 across 9.335e8 total cells [E[N_PSC,whole] = 93.35, whereas the 1e7-cell sub-lot screen sample itself has expectation 1.0 PSC], P_pre = 9.5270e-5 / P_post = 9.5270e-7 under 10,000x mosaic resistance [q_esc = 1.0099e-6] or P_pre = 2.0175e-6 / P_post = 2.0175e-8 under 10x mosaic resistance [q_esc = 0.01 * 1e-7 + 0.99 * 1e-8 = 1.09e-8]; MW-R6-S2-01, R9-S1-L1B-01 & AUDIT-REF [DEC-053/DEC-074/DEC-075]).

antiviral_sanctuary_and_cell_intrinsic_v.lead_product_tyk2_wt_policy: All lead clinical candidates (Embodiment A* ISLET1_A4_ARM1B, Arm 1X ISLET1_A4_X_MOL_RNLS_WT, and composite challenger ISLET1_COMP_R4_X_BFB_DXB_LOWLOAD1500) retain wild-type TYK2 (TYK2-WT) to preserve full IFNAR1/2-STAT1/2 Type-I interferon and IL-12/IL-23 antiviral innate immunity; optional TYK2 P1104A (rs34536443) satellite variants are strictly quarantined from clinical promotion unless they clear Stage-0 Gate 0V.
antiviral_sanctuary_and_cell_intrinsic_v.stage0_gate_0v_live_viral_challenge_prot: Challenge engineered SC-islet organoids at MOI 0.01 and 0.1 with diabetogenic Coxsackievirus B1/B3/B4 (CVB1/CVB3/CVB4, CXADR-tropic), human cytomegalovirus (HCMV), and Epstein-Barr virus (EBV) for 28 days in the presence of NK cells and autologous/allogeneic PBMCs; require >= 3.0 log10 reduction in viral genome copies by Day 14 (obs_gate0v_cvb_day14_log10_viral_reduction >= 3.0), 0% persistent VP1+ or IE1+ reservoir cells at Day 28 (obs_gate0v_day28_persistent_vp1_ie1_positive_cell_pct <= 0.0%), intact cytosolic RNA-sensing MDA5 (IFIH1) / RIG-I (DDX58) / MAVS pathway activation, and bystander uninfected beta-cell GSIS SI >= 2.5.
antiviral_sanctuary_and_cell_intrinsic_v.cell_intrinsic_mda5_rigi_mavs_intactness: Verify intact cell-intrinsic MDA5 (IFIH1) / RIG-I (DDX58) / MAVS -> IRF3/IFN-beta/IFN-lambda1 induction upon poly(I:C) or CVB1/CVB4 challenge so enteroviral abortive clearance operates autonomously upstream of MHC-I/CD8+ CTLs.

cell_intrinsic_viral_fuse_challenger.mechanism: Cell-intrinsic viral-replication-triggered abortive suicide fuse (dsRNA-sensing PKR/OAS1-RNase L or IFIH1/MAVS-inducible caspase-9/GSDME circuit) that selectively aborts virally infected cells before virion assembly and paracrine spread without requiring MHC-I/CD8+ CTL recognition.

coupled_shield_switch_coinheritance_and_.co_inherited_locus1_surface_eraser_tag_c: Co-inheritance challenger coupling an antibody-depletable compact surface tag (RQR8 or tEGFR) or bicistronic CD47-P2A-iCasp9 / orthogonal second suicide switch directly into the Locus-1 B2M immune-shield bicistron so that promoter-level epigenetic silencing or whole-locus LOH obligately co-silences HLA-E/CD47 and exposes the cell to immediate innate NK/macrophage clearance, while independent AAVS1 iCasp9 is retained alongside because downstream coding frameshift or P2A ribosome skipping (~5-15% incomplete cleavage) does not abrogate upstream HLA-E/CD47 translation.
coupled_shield_switch_coinheritance_and_.dual_orthogonal_eraser_requirement: Require two mechanistically independent elimination modalities (AAVS1 iCasp9/AP1903 monotherapy + orthogonal cell-surface antibody-mediated CDC/ADCC or HSV-TK/ganciclovir backup), each independently achieving >= 4-log10 depletion under combined 1% O2 hypoxia + 20q11.21/BCL2L1 trisomy.
coupled_shield_switch_coinheritance_and_.post_stress_20q11_outgrowth_assay: Subject 10^8 differentiated Stage-7 cells to 72-h 1% O2 hypoxia + IFN-g/TNF-a/IL-1b + sub-lethal AP1903 cycling followed by 28-day outgrowth, requiring zero positive selection or clonal enrichment of 20q11.21/BCL2L1 copy number or TP53/PPM1D/BCOR variants (obs_post_stress_20q11_bcl2l1_outgrowth_fold <= 1.0 point estimate and upper95 <= 1.20x) and functional p53 Nutlin-3a response >= 5.0x (obs_nutlin3a_p21_mdm2_fold_induction >= 5.0).

wt_iapp_pouch_accumulation_and_pramlinti.pouch_iapp_mass_balance: 40 IU/day insulin (~240 nmol/day) co-secretes 2.4-12.0 nmol/day human WT IAPP (at 1-5% molar ratio); distributed into a 7.0 mL pouch volume with restricted macromolecular washout and matrix binding, local interstitial WT IAPP generation reaches 0.34-1.71 uM/day, crossing the micromolar nucleation threshold for toxic beta-sheet oligomerization and NLRP3 inflammasome IL-1beta activation (Westermark et al. 2008 PMID:18753660; Masters et al. 2010 PMID:20835230).
wt_iapp_pouch_accumulation_and_pramlinti.conditional_lead_promotion_rule: Stage-0 Gate 0E-amyloid runs a 7-to-14-day confined high-glucose (16.7 mM) + exogenous preformed WT human IAPP fibril-seeding challenge in the 350-um hydrogel coupon; if WT IAPP exhibits Thioflavin-T (ThT) amyloid area > 1.0% (> 2.0x baseline), A11 toxic oligomer positivity, macrophage NLRP3 IL-1beta release (> 50 pg/mL), or > 3-5% beta-cell caspase-3/apoptosis, non-amyloidogenic pramlintide-like IAPP(A25P/S28P/S29P) (product candidate ISLET1_A4_IAPP_PRAM / satellite coupon ER_IAPP_PRAMLINTIDE_RNLS_WT, K=0 DSBs, B=1 base edit) is promoted via sequential DSB-free base editing (or paired only with DSB-only K<=4 stacks so simultaneous base-editor burden remains B<=1 and avoids the GRAVEYARD_006 B>=2 WARN engineering-complexity discount rule; DEC-054/057/058).

bounded_intermediate_endocrine_mixture_c.scope_and_non_conflation_note: Supplements the 60:30:10 reference and fixed-beta / fixed-total beta-only boundary controls (ISLET-1-BLUEPRINT.md:244-246) with a bounded, staged intermediate-mixture comparison motivated by Perez-Frances et al. 2024 PMID:39169271 (human primary beta-cell pseudoislets in vitro GSIS/OCR in Figure 7 and adult-mouse in vivo regulation) and counter-balanced by Meng et al. 2025 PMID:40782792 (reconstructed endocrine-subtype-complete human PSC-islets). Changes neither the 60:30:10 reference recipe nor any existing dynamic-function gate (scripts/wetlab_contract.py:1855-1867) or release threshold.
staged_protocol_clauses: 1. Screen at fixed total input first: use blocked, randomised sibling preparations of R=60:30:10 and M1=70:20:10, M2=70:25:5, M3=80:15:5, M4=80:10:10 (M1/M2 lower-perturbation priorities if capacity-limited) with existing beta-only boundary controls; keep assigned recipe primary while directly measuring input-stream purity (up to 80% live beta enrichment in Veres et al. 2019 PMID:31068696 is an enrichment step, not measured purity or a universal ceiling), achieved composition, post-handling recovery, aggregate size/volume, and process losses.

2. Measure whole-preparation function and burden: under the same declared glucose/oxygen waveform, retain raw traces, incremental insulin/C-peptide output U, absolute low-glucose glucagon output G, basal secretion, stimulation/first-phase measures, both t50 and t90 shut-off, and identity/processing readouts (per preparation and per starting/surviving beta and alpha populations), alongside total tissue volume V, state-qualified oxygen consumption Q, and starting-cell/process burden H.

3. Select once; confirm independently: advance at most one candidate from the blocked screen on the measured functional/burden trade-off and confirm on new independent differentiation blocks at fixed viable-beta input and at a directly measured equal-output dose (verified on new preparations, not inferred from beta fraction, SI, or the selected screen), without multiplying mixture dose savings by unqualified folded-area credit.

4. Predeclare the decision before confirmation: state the binding problem, material benefit, and functional precision required to change the recipe; retain existing dynamic gates and 60:30:10 if a justified functional margin is unavailable rather than treating an imprecise non-significant difference as equivalence.

5. Keep model predictions subordinate to their calibration: Layer 4 recipe fractions (scripts/run_layer4_tissue_and_metabolic_twin.py:4220-4222,4643-4645) are recorded metadata that do not scale the ODE right-hand side as lineage masses, so modelled exercise nadirs and per-alpha glucagon multipliers (~1.3x to 4x across M1-M4 and paracrine-scaling variants at equal beta mass) remain sensitivity analyses rather than mandatory recipe-advancement gates.

perk_eif2a_hypoxic_er_stress_translation.mechanism: 5'TOP deletion (5'-CAGAGA-3') prevents mTORC1/LARP1 selective repression of ribosomal/EEF1A1 5'TOP mRNAs, but PERK-mediated eIF2-alpha Ser51 phosphorylation under combined hypoxia + inflammatory ER stress depletes global ternary complex (eIF2-GTP-Met-tRNAi^Met) across all cap-dependent non-uORF transcripts (Koritzinsky et al. 2006 PMID:16467844; Gomez et al. 2008 PMID:18052927).

second_order_gzmb_capture_kinetics_and_n.gzmm_mediated_serpinb9_cleavage_inactiva: NK-enriched Granzyme M (GzmM, Met-ase/Leu-ase) not only cleaves nucleophosmin and alpha-tubulin independently of SERPINB9, but directly cleaves the SERPINB9 (PI-9) reactive-center loop as a non-inhibitory substrate to generate an inactive ~40-kDa cleaved serpin species, accelerating depletion of functional cytosolic SERPINB9 during NK degranulation (Mahrus et al. 2004 J Biol Chem PMID:15494398; AUDIT-REF & L2-B).

serpinb9_rcl_vicinal_cys341_cys342_redox.primary_citation: Mangan et al. 2016 J Biol Chem PMID:26670609
serpinb9_rcl_vicinal_cys341_cys342_redox.oxidative_inactivation_mechanism: SERPINB9 contains a vicinal Cys341-Cys342 dyad at P1'-P2' of its reactive-center loop (337-VVAECCMES-345) immediately C-terminal to the P1=Glu340 cleavage residue. Under inflammatory ROS/H2O2, Cys341-Cys342 forms a reversible vicinal disulfide bond that constrains RCL conformation and abolishes Granzyme B inhibition (Mangan et al. 2016 PMID:26670609). Layer 4 interstitial catalase (keeping [H2O2]_max <= 10 uM) and TXNIP-/- thioredoxin preservation mitigate cytosolic oxidation, and the redox-resistant SERPINB9(C341S/C342S) RCL variant is pre-registered as a Stage-0 Gate 0C-kinetic oxidative-stress challenger (AUDIT-REF & L2-B).

second_order_gzmb_capture_kinetics_and_n.non_gzmb_granzyme_and_death_ligand_scope: SERPINB9 (PI-9) is a specific suicide inhibitor of Granzyme B (reactive-center P1=Glu340) and does not inhibit tryptase/chymase-like Granzyme A, Granzyme K, or Granzyme M (which is inhibited by SERPINB4 and cleaves SERPINB9; Mahrus et al. 2004 PMID:15494398; de Koning et al. 2011 PMID:21857942) or extrinsic FasL/TRAIL -> Caspase-8 signaling; upstream NK/CTL degranulation suppression therefore relies on Arm 1B/1X/B'-SCT inhibitory receptor engagement (CD94/NKG2A, KIR2DL1/2/3, SIRPa, PD-L1) and peri-graft SA-FasL/SA-THBD microgels, while Gate 0C-kinetic measures net primary NK/CTL Annexin-V+/Caspase-3/7 apoptosis in the presence and absence of selective GzmB inhibitor Compound 20 / Z-AAD-CMK to partition GzmB vs GzmA/M/FasL residual death.

serpinb9_suicide_substrate_serial_pulse_.stage0_serial_hit_gate_0c_extension: Gate 0C-kinetic includes both a 3-pulse acute serial NK/CTL degranulation screen (every 2 h at E:T = 2:1 under pO2 = 10 mmHg + 100 U/mL IFN-gamma + 10 ng/mL TNF-alpha, post-pulse-3 Annexin-V+ <= 20%) and a full 12-pulse (24-h, q2h at E:T = 5:1) hypoxic combined-stress confirmation arm verifying that upstream synaptic degranulation suppression (p_degran <= 0.15 via HLA-E/HLA-C SCT/PD-L1) + L3-BF-B scar-free SI ~ 1.0 prevent cumulative SERPINB9 exhaustion (<= 8% specific lysis; AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).

stochastic_12_pulse_bernoulli_breakthrou.reconciliation_note_astra6_r5: Retracts the unverified 0.036957 literal for s0 = 0.30 uM and replaces it with exact 2^12 = 4,096-trajectory enumeration across all three physical replenishment regimes (AUDIT-REF [DEC-046] & AUDIT-REF [DEC-059]): (1) if contact at Hour 0 triggers immediate IFN-gamma/NF-kB licensing toward the hypoxic induced target s_inf = 0.89 * 0.45 = 0.4005 uM, breakthrough probability is 0.026922 [0.026922123343 exact] (2.69%); (2) if maintained at normoxic basal target s_inf = 0.30 uM (f_ISR = 1.0), breakthrough probability is 0.120153 (12.02%, > 8%); (3) if maintained under unprimed hypoxic ISR attenuation s_inf = 0.30 * 0.45 = 0.135 uM (without cytokine licensing), deterministic full-hit challenge exhausts at Pulse 2 (post-Pulse-1 0.15 uM -> pre-Pulse-2 0.1469 uM < 0.15 uM) and i.i.d. Bernoulli(0.15) breakthrough is 0.581642 (58.16%, > 8%); and (4) if synaptic hits are spatially correlated across the 12 pulses (e.g. 15% border cells hit every pulse while 85% interior cells are never hit, giving the same marginal p = 0.15), population breakthrough is 15.0% even from 0.89 uM. Therefore Gate 0C-kinetic explicitly tests both an unprimed Hour-0 hypoxic 12-pulse arm (obs_12pulse_unprimed_hypoxic_serial_lysis_pct <= 8.0%) and a 24-h cytokine-licensed 12-pulse arm.

twelve_pulse_hypoxic_coupon_reconciliati.reconciliation_rule: Explicitly reconciles the 6-pulse vs 12-pulse serial GzmB ODE envelopes under hypoxic ISR translation attenuation (f_ISR = 0.45 at pO2 = 8-12 mmHg, k_d = ln(2)/6 h^-1, SI = 1.0): if every 2-h NK/CTL contact injected a full unattenuated 0.15 uM cytosolic GzmB bolus, intracellular L3-BF-B SERPINB9 alone would provide a 6-pulse autonomous intracellular buffer from a pre-loaded 0.89 uM IFN-gamma state before exhausting at Pulse 7 (0.0599 uM unneutralized GzmB; and at Pulse 4 from a hypoxia-equilibrated 0.4005 uM start [0.038049 uM unneutralized; pre-pulse 0.111951 uM] or Pulse 2 from the 0.30 uM Hour-0 basal floor under unprimed f_ISR = 0.45 [0.003094 uM unneutralized; vs Pulse 3 under normoxic f_ISR = 1.0 with 0.063549 uM unneutralized]), because steady-state 2-h resynthesis under f_ISR = 0.45 replaces at most 0.4005 * (1 - exp(-2*ln(2)/6)) = 0.0826 uM per 2-h interval (< 0.15 uM). Therefore, surviving the 24-h / 12-pulse combined-stress coupon (<= 8% specific lysis) is NOT achieved by cytosolic SERPINB9 stoichiometry in isolation, but requires upstream synaptic degranulation suppression (p_degran <= 0.15 per contact via Arm 1B/1X HLA-E -> CD94/NKG2A or B'-SCT HLA-C -> KIR2DL plus Locus-3 PD-L1 -> PD-1 and peri-graft SA-FasL, keeping average effective GzmB delivery at 0.15 * 0.15 = 0.0225 uM per 2-h contact wave [<= 0.0826 uM steady-state 2-h resynthesis ceiling] and restricting discrete Bernoulli breakthrough probability across 2^12 = 4,096 trajectories to 0.234% [preloaded 0.89 uM] to 1.576% [hypoxia-equilibrated 0.4005 uM]; AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF [DEC-044/045]).

common_mode_epigenetic_silencing_and_en_.per_cell_vs_per_graft_common_mode_parame: Distinguishes two distinct common-mode parameters (AUDIT-REF [DEC-046]): (a) Layer-2 p_common_cell in [10^-6, 10^-5] is a per-proliferating-cell trans-epigenetic/apoptotic resistance rate (giving p_cell = p_common_cell + (1 - p_common_cell)*10^-8, expected surviving proliferating cells E = 93,350 * p_cell = 0.0943 to 0.9344 per dose, and Poisson dose-level escape probability P(>=1 survivor) = 1 - exp(-E) = 8.9975% to 60.7192%, which exceeds the 0.1% patient-level target by 90x-607x); whereas (b) Layer-1 q_common_graft <= 6.6998e-5 is a per-graft/per-batch catastrophic failure probability in P_escape_graft = q_common_graft + (1 - q_common_graft)*(1 - (1 - p_cell)^93350) <= 10^-3, which at q_common_graft = 6.6998e-5 matches the 10^-3 total dose-level ceiling when per-cell escape is at the two-independent-allele floor p_cell = p_ind^2 = 10^-8 (leaving remaining cell-level headroom p_cell <= 1.00000094e-8, i.e. p_common_cell <= 9.4e-16 when q_common_graft = 6.6998e-5 is simultaneously active, whereas under a pure cell-level budget q_common_graft = 0 the 10^-3 dose-level ceiling allows p_cell <= 1.0718e-8, i.e. per-cell p_common_cell <= 7.18e-10; DEC-078). This 90x-607x gap under realistic per-cell trans-silencing is why pharmacological suicide switches (iCasp9 / RQR8) cannot be claimed as a standalone <= 10^-3 patient-level guarantee and why primary physical containment + en-bloc surgical retrievability (Gate 0S-Retrieval) is mandatory.

dual_orthogonal_suicide_switch_challenge.orthogonal_second_switch: GAPDH::EEF1A1-RQR8 (extrinsic rituximab CDC/ADCC surface epitope, bypassing intracellular XIAP/BCL-xL/APAF1 blocks) or HSV-TK(SR39) (ganciclovir DNA chain termination targeting dividing cells)
dual_orthogonal_suicide_switch_challenge.why_gate_0s_surgical_retrieval_remains_m: Even with an orthogonal second suicide switch (RQR8/rituximab or HSV-TK/ganciclovir) at a second safe harbor, a 5e8-cell total graft still has E=5.0 surviving cells (P(>=1)=99.33%) at a 10^-8 per-cell escape ceiling and 0.0943-0.9344 expected proliferating escapees across the 93,350 pan-lineage Ki67+ subpopulation under p_common = 10^-6-10^-5 (plus macromolecular IgG/complement diffusion limits inside a fibrotic capsule for RQR8); therefore pharmacological suicide switches serve as >=4-5 log debulking adjuncts while primary physical containment and en-bloc surgical retrievability of the dual omental pouches (Gate 0S-Retrieval) provide the definitive clinical fail-safe (AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF [DEC-044/045]).

common_mode_epigenetic_silencing_and_en_.primary_containment_and_surgical_retriev: Because both alleles of biallelic AAVS1::cHS4-A2UCOE-EEF1A1-iCasp9 (or dual-safe-harbor AAVS1 + GAPDH) reside inside the same trans-acting nuclear DNMT3A/3B/KAP1/HUSH and post-mitotic beta-cell XIAP/BCL-xL environment, single-cell AP1903 escape follows the common-mode mixture model P_escape_cell = p_common + (1 - p_common) * p_ind^2 rather than a pure independent product p_ind^2 = 10^-8 (Wunderlich et al. 2022 PMID:35795779; Ordovas et al. 2015 PMID:26455413). Consequently: (1) Stage-0 Gate S9 enforces a cumulative MCB clonogenic trial floor of N_eff >= ceil(-ln(0.05)/10^-8) = 299,573,228 effective clonogenic trials (896,925,831 physical cells at eta = 0.334) after 35-day Stage 0->7 differentiation + 14-day cytokine/hypoxia culture with 0 surviving colonies; and (2) for human translation, iCasp9 + AP1903 is positioned as an adjunct pharmacological debulking switch (>= 4-5 log reduction) paired with primary mechanical containment and en-bloc surgical retrievability of the dual pre-vascularized omental scaffold pouches (Gate 0S-Retrieval; AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF [DEC-044/045]).

nkg2c_3cdg_homolog_substitution_audit.structural_mechanism_note: All 6 NKG2A->NKG2C ectodomain substitutions lie >4.5 A from HLA-E/B2M/peptide in PDB:3CDG (closest is Ile225 at 5.57 A and loop residues Ser167/Ile168/Ser170 at 5.90-5.97 A), whereas Ile168 (3.61 A) and Ser170 (3.38 A) directly pack against CD94 Chain J at the heterodimer interface—matching Kaiser et al. 2008 (PMID:18448674) that NKG2A/NKG2C affinity divergence is governed allosterically by the NKG2 167-170 (NKG2C 165-168) heterodimer loop orientation rather than direct P8-NKG2 contact.

source_citations: Vales-Gomez et al. 1999 PMID:10428963 Table I

vmaprtlvl_vs_vmaprtlfl_nkg2a_nkg2c_selec.scope_and_limitations_note: In PDB:3CDG, all P8-Phe8 heavy-atom contacts (24 in copy 1 P->J/K, 21 in copy 2 Q->E/F) are to the shared CD94 subunit (copy 1 J: J:SER111, J:GLN112, J:PHE114, J:ASN156, J:ASN158; copy 2 E: E:PHE114, E:ASN156, E:ASN158, E:ASN160) and 0 are to NKG2A; furthermore, deleting Phe ring atoms (CD1/CD2/CE1/CE2/CZ) is an atom-truncation diagnostic (leaving 2 and 1 contacts), not a modeled Val8 rotamer. Therefore, 3CDG coordinates alone do NOT provide an atomic proof of NKG2A-over-NKG2C selectivity. Primary SPR references report ~4.6-6.5-fold receptor-intrinsic CD94/NKG2A vs CD94/NKG2C selectivity on VMAPRTLFL (Kaiser et al. 2008 PMID:18448674 Table 1: WT NKG2A K_D = 0.8 +/- 0.055 uM vs WT NKG2C K_D = 5.2 +/- 0.2 uM [6.5x], with loop swap NKG2C[165-168SIIS] restoring K_D = 0.9 +/- 0.1 uM; Vales-Gomez et al. 1999 PMID:10428963 Table I: NKG2A K_D = 2.33 uM vs NKG2C K_D = 10.77 uM [4.6223x] for VMAPRTLFL, and NKG2A K_D = 7.35 uM for HLA-Cw*0302 VMAPRTLIL [vs >=75.30 uM for HLA-Cw*0402 VMEPRTLIL] / 11.23 uM for HLA-B*0702 VMAPRTVLL), while exact covalent single-chain HLA-E*01:03(VMAPRTLVL) trimer affinity requires direct Stage-0 SPR and HCMV+ NKG2C+ adaptive NK validation (AUDIT-REF).

hlae_alpha3_d227_t228_distance_audit.structural_interpretation_note: In PDB:3CDG across both asymmetric-unit copies, HLA-E alpha3 CD8-loop residues Asp227 and Thr228 lie 47.00-50.70 A from the bound CD94/NKG2A heterodimer (47.00-52.06 A across individual CD94 and NKG2A subunits) and 10.88-12.33 A from B2M (no direct B2M contact <= 4.5 A; WT alpha3 Asp227/Thr228 is the conditional default [W_D = -1 in the 8-run 2^3 Stage-0 factorial] to preserve HLA-E-restricted CD8+ Treg licensing, while optional alpha3 D227K/T228A [W_D = +1] is a conditional Stage-0 satellite coupon requiring DSF T_m qualification, SPR CD8 K_D > 1,000 uM, CD94/NKG2A K_D <= 2.5 uM, 0/6 CMV+ UL40 CTL donors > 5.0% lysis, and >= 80% CD8+ Treg suppression retention; R9-S1-L3A-01 [DEC-077]).

vmaprtlvl_vs_vmaprtlfl_nkg2a_nkg2c_selec.qualification_note: All P8 contacts in 3CDG are to the common CD94 subunit (24 in copy 1, 21 in copy 2; 0 to NKG2A) and do not structurally discriminate NKG2A from NKG2C. Kaiser et al. 2008 (PMID:18448674 Table 1) measured HLA-G leader VMAPRTLFL (WT CD94/NKG2A K_D = 0.8 +/- 0.055 uM, WT CD94/NKG2C K_D = 5.2 +/- 0.2 uM, loop-swap NKG2C[165-168SIIS] K_D = 0.9 +/- 0.1 uM), Vales-Gomez et al. 1999 (PMID:10428963 Table I) measured VMAPRTLFL (2.33 vs 10.77 uM [4.6223x]), HLA-Cw*0302 VMAPRTLIL (7.35 uM vs >=75.30 uM for HLA-Cw*0402 VMEPRTLIL), and HLA-B*0702 VMAPRTVLL (11.23 uM), and Lin et al. 2023 (PMID:37264229 Supplementary Table 1) measured soluble refolded HLA-E*01:03 with non-covalent VMAPRTLVL (CD94/NKG2A K_D = 2.10 uM [95% CI 1.93-2.28] vs CD94/NKG2C K_D = 6.52 uM [6.41-6.63], ~3.1x selectivity), SP-1C VMAPRTLIL (1.33 vs 4.35 uM), and SP-2C VMAPRTLLL (1.70 vs 4.97 uM); however, exact covalent HLA-E*01:03(VMAPRTLVL) single-chain trimer (SCT) K_D with the (G4S)3/(G4S)4 L1 linker remains unmeasured (None) and requires direct Stage-0 SPR and HCMV+ NKG2C+ adaptive NK / HLA-E-restricted TCR donor-panel testing (AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).

designed_vs_crystallized_cd47_sequence_i.crystal_2JJS_chainC_pca1_edman_and_lcms_: Mature CD47 Gln19 (2JJS Chain C residue 1) is converted to N-terminal 5-oxoproline / pyroglutamate (HETATM PCA1, -17.03 Da via NH3 loss; catalyzed enzymatically in cells by glutaminyl cyclase QPCTL per Logtenberg et al. 2019 Nat Med PMID:30833751 alongside low-rate spontaneous cyclization), which lacks a free alpha-amino group and blocks phenylisothiocyanate (PITC) Edman degradation unless enzymatically deblocked with pyroglutamate aminopeptidase (PGP, which excises N-terminal pGlu to expose Leu2 for Edman sequencing rather than reverting pGlu to Gln), whereas intact/top-down LC-MS directly resolves the intact-chain -17.03 Da mass shift (AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).
designed_vs_crystallized_cd47_sequence_i.structural_and_thiol_qualification_note: Full-length native CD47 forms a long-range inter-domain disulfide between IgV Cys33 (mature Cys15) and Cys263 at the extracellular loop / transmembrane boundary, whereas soluble crystal structures 2JJS (Hatherley et al. 2008 PMID:18657508), 4CMM (Hatherley et al. 2014 PMID:24550402), and 4KJY (Weiskopf et al. 2013 PMID:23722425) mutated Cys33->Gly (mature C15G) to prevent unpaired-thiol dimerization in soluble expression, and our designed CD47-IgV-GPI retains wild-type Cys33 (following Xu et al. 2024 Cell Rep Med PMID:38508139 membrane-anchored CD47-IgV). Therefore, soluble C15G crystal coordinates do not settle the free-thiol/disulfide state or membrane orientation of wild-type Cys33 CD47-IgV-GPI; Stage-0 pre-pilot must compare wild-type Cys33 vs C33G CD47-IgV-GPI via non-reducing SDS-PAGE, Ellman/maleimide free-thiol labeling, PI-PLC sensitivity, and SIRPa V1/V2/V8 binding.
