r01_c_terminal_tpt2a_tail_and_rcl_suicid.s_to_r_and_acyl_enzyme_structural_qualif: Unmodified AF-P50453-F1 models only the stressed (S) native monomer prior to Granzyme B docking, and PDB:8ZCR (superseding 8H4X) resolves only the RCL-cleaved relaxed (R) state without a C-terminal 2A extension; neither structure resolves the 1:1 covalent SERPINB9:Granzyme B acyl-enzyme trap or S->R beta-sheet A insertion kinetics.
r01_c_terminal_tpt2a_tail_and_rcl_suicid.rcl_low_plddt_and_high_pae_coordinate_un: Because AF-P50453-F1 predicts mobile RCL residues at low local coordinate confidence (residues 335-350 coordinate mean pLDDT = 53.30; recognition loop 335-345 coordinate mean = 36.21 [min 25.48 at Cys335, 29.20 at P1'-Cys341, max 59.00 at Ser345]; hinge-to-P3' loop 322-348 coordinate mean = 48.36; P1-Glu340 = 31.52, P1'-Cys341 = 29.20; global coordinate mean = 91.16 [AFDB v6 summary API metadata = 91.19; AF-P10144-F1 global coordinate mean = 92.41, API summary = 92.44]) and high inter-domain positional uncertainty relative to the serpin beta-sheet core (RCL 335-345 vs core 1-322 mean PAE = 27.29 A; aligned core 1-322 scored RCL 335-345 mean PAE = 15.20 A; single rigid domain 1-325), static Pro376->RCL heavy-atom clearances (26.13 A [28.57 A from Pro376.C] to 335-345, 12.55 A [15.07 A from Pro376.C] to s1C Cys350, 10.40 A [11.21 A from Pro376.C; 12.02 A CA-CA] to hinge Val322) are accompanied by 15.20-27.29 A AlphaFold directional expected positional error (PAE, which is an expected pairwise alignment error in Angstroms rather than a calibrated symmetric +/- probabilistic confidence interval) and are order-of-magnitude geometric priors that cannot substitute for Decision Experiment #3 recombinant GzmB k_ass and SI measurements (S55R2-D3-05, AUDIT-REF, AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF).
r01_c_terminal_tpt2a_tail_and_rcl_suicid.structural_and_conformational_uncertaint: In unmodified AF-P50453-F1, Pro376 is 34.26 A from P1-Glu340 CA, 12.02 A from proximal-hinge Val322 CA, and 24.05 A (C-terminal sheet 372-376 Phe373.CE1<->Ser345.CB; 26.13 A Pro376-only Pro376.CG<->Ser345.CB; 28.57 A from peptide-bond anchor Pro376.C<->Ser345.CB) from RCL recognition residues 335-345 (21.38 A from 372-376 / 24.20 A Pro376-only to 337-346 via Gly346.O; 9.77 A from 372-376 [Phe373.CD1<->Cys350.C] / 12.55 A Pro376-only [Pro376.CD<->Cys350.O] / 15.07 A Pro376.C across full mobile RCL 335-350 including s1C anchor Cys350; 7.96 A from 372-376 [Phe373.CD2<->Val322.CG2] / 10.40 A Pro376-only [Pro376.OXT<->Val322.O] / 11.21 A Pro376.C to proximal hinge 318-334; unmodified serpin-intrinsic heavy-atom distances; no bound SERPINB9:Granzyme B complex structure is claimed). The mobile RCL has low local prediction confidence (residues 335-350 mean pLDDT = 53.30, 335-345 mean pLDDT = 36.21, Glu340 = 31.52, Cys341 = 29.20); while the 21-aa WLC RMS extension (23.58 A) is below both the 24.05 A (372-376) and 28.57 A (Pro376.C anchor) P6-P5' recognition-loop clearances, it exceeds the 9.77 A / 15.07 A s1C (Cys350) and 7.96 A / 11.21 A proximal-hinge (Val322) clearances, and its 73.50 A contour upper bound (as well as 26-aa 91.0 A and 50-aa 175.0 A contours) exceeds 24.05 A. Whether the 21-aa GSG-P2A stub perturbs S->R serpin loop insertion must be resolved empirically by measuring k_ass and SI against recombinant human Granzyme B alongside a 2A-free control (Decision Experiment #3).

finite_width_lamina_vs_thin_sheet_zero_o.derivation_note: For zero-order consumption across [-L, L] with a central source lamina of half-width fraction a = 0.34, the exact two-branch piecewise zero-order threshold for min_{z} p(z) >= 15.0 mmHg is f_b1 = (1 - r)/(2 - a) when f_b1 <= a (r >= (1 - a)^2, minimum at z = 0; e.g. 2,500 pure -> f = 0.3136659) and f_b2 = 1 - sqrt(r) when f_b1 > a (r < (1 - a)^2, where z = 0 is a local maximum and the global minimum occurs in the outer passive annulus at |z| = f*L > a*L; e.g. 2,500+iEC -> f = 0.3544032, 3,000+iEC -> f = 0.4106534). Verified to 5 decimal places (15.00000 mmHg) against the 4,001-node FD BVP solver across all loading regimes.

Over the 72-hour avascular bridge, exponential decay yields a 0-72h time-averaged chemical supply fraction of 0.3188 (31.88%), while the total loaded CaO2 inventory equals 0.6131 (61.31%) of 72-hour cumulative graft+iEC O2 demand because progressive iEC vascular anastomosis (t_50 = 36.0 h in a 14-day pre-vascularized bed) takes over O2 delivery from Hour 24 onward.

joint_vascular_iip_0002.title: Test delayed and reduced vascular oxygen support together
joint_vascular_iip_0002.open_question_title: Does the oxygen supply hold up under pessimistic assumptions?
joint_vascular_iip_0002.credit: Marissa Famularo (ORCID 0009-0001-8032-2215, GitHub @MarissaFamularo), IIP-0002, https://github.com/OpenIslet/openislet/issues/2. AI tools as she reported them: ChatGPT, GPT-6 Astra Pro (self-reported, never verified).
joint_vascular_iip_0002.exploratory_engineering_scope_note: Exploratory engineering sensitivity grid characterizing the combined early-window interaction of vascular inosculation timing and internal vascular exchange across both CaO2 release laws. Neither cited paper calibrates the chosen timing values, oxygen-transfer coefficients, or their joint distribution. Grid corners are exploratory model-dependence stress settings, not experimentally calibrated worst cases or clinical probabilities.

timing_axis_specification.lag_ode_equation: dv_perf/dt = (v_target(t) - v_perf(t)) / 3.0, v_perf(0) = 0.01 (or v_perf(t) == 0 in exact zero-vessel bound)
timing_axis_specification.realized_half_plateau_definition: Time t (hours) at which realized v_perf(t) reaches 0.5 * v_max = 0.485

coupled_processes_controlled_by_kp: Internal vascular O2 exchange: +k_perf_s(t) * (P_boundary - p(z, t)) in the slab O2 reaction-diffusion BVP (acts as an O2 source when local p < P_boundary = 40 mmHg, and as an O2 sink wherever local chemical O2 release raises p > 40 mmHg)
Interstitial H2O2 vascular washout: -k_perf_s(t) * [H2O2](z, t) in _solve_peroxide_slab_bvp (removing H2O2 before catalase disproportionation reduces local chemical O2 generation)
Interstitial OH- / alkaline species clearance: -k_perf_s(t) * [OH-](z, t) in the Henderson-Hasselbalch pH BVP
coupled_vascular_exchange_axis_disclosur.interpretation_note: Because k_perf_s(t) = k_p * v_perf(t) simultaneously governs O2 exchange, H2O2 washout (which reduces catalase-mediated chemical O2 yield), and OH- clearance, and becomes an O2 sink wherever local pO2 exceeds the 40 mmHg host boundary, k_p is reported as a coupled internal vascular-exchange parameter rather than a pure oxygen-delivery coefficient.

design_geometry_and_gy004_oxygen_demand_.reference_architecture_evaluated: LEAD_CENTRAL_LAMINA_PDMS_CAO2_F045_PLUS_CATALASE (350 um total slab thickness, 119 um central lamina [a = 0.34], uniform conservative cellular demand, 120 um cluster diameter [R = 60 um], 2,500 IEQ/cm^2 across 200 cm^2 [7.00 cm^3], D_O2,gel = 9.40254e-6 cm^2/s)

gy004_oxygen_consumption_consistency.graveyard_entry: GY-004 (RNLS knockout excluded from lead backbone due to ~1.18x basal OCR elevation)
gy004_oxygen_consumption_consistency.cross_design_transferability_caveat: All rows hold intrinsic cellular oxygen demand fixed at 1.0x baseline V_max (RNLS-WT, consistent with GY-004) plus the 1.15x vascular/stromal demand factor in the 350 um / 119 um-lamina / 120 um-cluster uniform-demand reference slab. Numerical outputs do not automatically transfer to Design A Layout B (outer_annulus demand), Design B (GY-004 RNLS-KO 1.18x OCR comparator), or Design X (100 um thinned central lamina with 80-100 um micro-islet diameter cap).

release_law_direction_flip_and_gate_brac.direction_flip_explanation: Under matched initial CaO2 inventory (10.981 mmol, 791.5 mg) and 68.0 h half-time, reaction-controlled shrinking-core (m/m0)^(2/3) release is lower than first-order release around the early 13-18 h trough when t50 = 36 h (min slab pO2 19.925 mmHg [FO, t=18 h, gel-only core 2.147 mmHg] vs 18.723 mmHg [SC, t=13 h, gel-only core 1.332 mmHg]), but retains slightly higher mid-trajectory chemical O2 release around the 36-39 h trough when inosculation is delayed to t50 = 60 h (min slab pO2 14.083 mmHg [FO, t=39 h, gel-only core 0.073 mmHg] vs 14.825 mmHg [SC, t=36 h, gel-only core 0.118 mmHg]), flipping the sign of (first_order - shrinking_core) between 36 h (+1.202 mmHg slab) and 60 h (-0.742 mmHg slab).

prior_repository_corner_tests_and_zero_v.novelty_boundary_statement: The zero-vessel case (k_p = 0, v_perf(t) == 0) is presented as an analytical/numerical lower bound (0.111602 mmHg [0.112 mmHg] minimum slab pO2 at 336 h under first-order release, 0.071825 mmHg [0.072 mmHg] at 330 h under shrinking-core release after finite-time CaO2 depletion at 329.62 h, with gel-only cluster cores 0.000001-0.000002 mmHg [0.000 mmHg] and uniform cores 0.000455-0.000707 mmHg), not as a newly introduced control. Earlier partial corner tests already existed in the repository; the specific addition of IIP-0002 is the systematic early transient timing-by-exchange crossing on the lead reference slab across both release laws.

existing_repository_partial_coverage_cit.description: Chronic post-CaO2 zero-source Design X capsule-dropout corner at k_perf = 0 s^-1 and d_cap = 50 um (delta_z_eq = 150 um), yielding min_slab_po2 = 0.0783 mmHg and 100-um/80-um cluster cores of 8.65e-6 / 7.50e-5 mmHg.
Design Z pre-vascularized ribbon target midpoint t50 = 24.0 h (and Stage-0 Gate Z-04 microfluidic anastomosis target t50 <= 24-36 h).
Separate one-at-a-time lead-slab sensitivity sweeps for delayed inosculation (t50 = 60 h at k_p = 0.14 s^-1) and reduced k_p (0.0944-0.1800 s^-1 at t50 = 36 h).

parameter_source_and_provenance_table.role_in_model: Logistic target-curve inflection time t50 in v_target(t) = v_max / (1 + exp(-(t - t50)/8.0)); realized half-plateau v_perf(t) = 0.485 occurs 2.9426 h later due to the 3.0 h first-order lag ODE.
parameter_source_and_provenance_table.source_and_provenance: Exploratory engineering sensitivity grid brackets. Shepherd et al. 2004 (Arterioscler Thromb Vasc Biol 24(5):898-904, PMID:14988090) demonstrates that microvessel-fragment constructs implanted in SCID mice can form perfused host connections early in engraftment, and Altalhi et al. 2019 (Cell Mol Bioeng 12(5):443-454, PMID:31719926 / PMC6816716 Fig. 6) shows reduced and delayed perfused vessel density in microvessel-fragment constructs in collagen hydrogels implanted subcutaneously in streptozotocin-diabetic donor+recipient mice relative to non-diabetic controls (confounded by simultaneous donor and recipient diabetic status). Neither cited paper calibrates the chosen timing values, oxygen-transfer coefficients, or their joint distribution.

parameter_source_and_provenance_table.role_in_model: Maximum internal vascular exchange rate constant multiplying v_perf(t) across O2 exchange, H2O2 washout, and OH- clearance.
parameter_source_and_provenance_table.source_and_provenance: Layer 4 continuum Krogh-type internal capillary exchange prior (nominal 0.14 s^-1, chronic capsule-attenuated 0.1358 s^-1, lower sensitivity brackets 0.1100 and 0.0944 s^-1, upper bracket 0.1800 s^-1; DEC-002 / AUDIT-REF). Neither cited paper calibrates the chosen timing values, oxygen-transfer coefficients, or their joint distribution.

parameter_source_and_provenance_table.role_in_model: Governs solid CaO2 hydrolysis rate at fixed initial inventory (10.981 mmol / 791.5 mg CaO2 in 7.00 cm^3) and matched t_1/2 = 68.0 h.
parameter_source_and_provenance_table.source_and_provenance: Layer 4 Stage-0 Gate P05 (DIFF-0) dual kinetic-law qualification bracket (DEC-002 / DEC-078).

parameter_source_and_provenance_table.role_in_model: Michaelis-Menten cellular O2 demand in the 350 um slab and 120 um spherical Wigner-Seitz cluster BVP.
parameter_source_and_provenance_table.source_and_provenance: Canonical human islet OCR prior with GY-004 consistency (RNLS-WT 1.0x baseline OCR retained across all lead-design rows).

sampled_ancestry_gap_method.method: hybrid deterministic low-discrepancy HWE stratification (coprime multiplier 997 mod 10000 for TYK2 rs34536443 and 7919 mod 1000 for KIR C1/C2 ligand group, paired with np.random.default_rng(20261023) binomial/Gaussian draws for SIRPA, IFIH1, PTPN22, HLA-E, BMI, and continuous NK/autoantigen/IFN-I covariates); analytic_expected_* metrics average exact survival probabilities p_i over the 2,000 sampled covariate profiles per cohort prior to Bernoulli indicator sampling (AUDIT-REF)

patient.model_classification_and_scope_note_sol_: Illustrative assigned-rule scenario simulation (NOT clinical trial data, fitted survival hazard model, or validated epidemiological forecast): each of the 10,000 virtual patient records is passed through compile_personalized_patient_blueprint() and evaluated against conditional assigned-rule penalties (base 0.982, unedited control fixed at 0.0) to check rule-consistency across Arm 1B (Hour-0 CD47-IgV floor), Plan B (HLA-C-retaining sub-bank for high KIR+ NKG2A- NK fractions), and TYK2 P1104A protection (closing AUDIT-REF).
patient.ancestry_disparity_gap_methodology_note_: The analytic primary model-implied ancestry gap is 0.40 pp before Bernoulli noise. hazard_active_cohort_sensitivity_audit_s.baseline_97p50_conditioning_scope: The 97.50% (92.84% K=5 [92.8363%] / 96.00% K=4 [96.0046%] complexity-discounted) personalized headline is conditioned on post-clearance grafts (all donor-panel Gate 0A NKG2C+, recipient serum CDC/ADCC crossmatch, and recipient CD8+ MLC non-reactivity holds cleared; AUDIT-REF [DEC-076]). Prior to crossmatch/MLC/Gate-0A clearance, sampling realistic recipient allorecognition and CMV adaptive-NK hazards yields the pre-clearance cohort sensitivity below.

competing_risks_baseline_provenance_reco.note: Reconciles the two baseline references: 97.4612% is the pre-DEC-048 historical cohort mean (yielding 86.5048% multiplicative and 85.7187% additive; 85.7575% in from_97p4612pct_4hazard_additive_survival_pct is the 100% - 14.2425% = 85.7575% 4-hazard additive reference retained for backward compatibility), whereas live pers_mean_4 = 97.4963% yields 86.5359% multiplicative and 85.7538% additive (M1 [DEC-077]).

population_simulation_with_cmv_nkg2c_and.clinical_interpretation: Illustrative assigned-penalty competing-risks sensitivity model: without Stage-0 Gate 0A NKG2C+/SIRPa-low NK clearance, Gate 0D 50-serum non-HLA/SCT flow crossmatch, and modular 3-4 x 100 cm^2 omental cassette area scaling (<= 1,500 IEQ/cm^2), unscreened cohort survival drops from 97.50% to 85.76% (85.7575% under additive 4-hazard sum h1+h2+h3+h4 = 0.142425; 86.5048% under 97.50%-baseline 4-term multiplicative competing risks and 86.4915% under 100%-baseline 4-hazard multiplicative competing risks 100% * (1-0.025)*(1-0.04425)*(1-0.036)*(1-0.037175)) or 59.5% (single-pouch anoxic overload), confirming why both recipient screening gates and modular 3-4 x 100 cm^2 cassette scaling are mandatory.

endogenous_hlac_retention_product_demoti.reason: Retaining endogenous polymorphic HLA-C + WT B2M with only a 3-line KIR-ligand-group bank (C1/C1, C2/C2, C1/C2) leaves ~70-85% of recipients 4-digit mismatched at HLA-C, re-arming direct CD8+ T-cell allorecognition and anti-HLA-C DSA (Xu et al. 2019 PMID:30853558; Tran et al. 2011 PMID:21743387) while requiring 3-pass clonal editing to avoid the 1.41 Mb chr6p21.3 HLA-A-to-HLA-B cis-deletion. Design B'-SCT (ISLET1_B_SCT_C1_CIITA [GAVDPLLAL, PDB:1EFX] / ISLET1_B_SCT_C2_CIITA [QYDDAVYKL, PDB:1IM9] at CIITA Exon 5) retains B2M-/- at Locus 1 and expresses a covalently tethered human self-peptide single-chain trimer at K=4, B=0 (P_passes=2) or B=1 (P_passes=3).

mcb_donor_genetic_and_serological_hygien.rationale: Eliminates H-Y (UTY/DBY/SMCY) minor histocompatibility antigens in female recipients, A/B glycocalyx neoantigens, and donor-derived latent herpesvirus reactivation (MW-R6-S1-19).

peri_operative_14day_damp_inflammation_a.high_risk_z_ge_2p0_optional_local_or_tra: Recipient-stratified transient 14-day peri-implantation anti-inflammatory/co-stimulatory blockade or hydrogel-tethered local anti-TNFa/IL-1Ra scavenging during capsule maturation

tyk2_independent_autoimmune_memory_and_i.tyk2_p1104a_pathway_scope: TYK2 P1104A (rs34536443 C/C) selectively dampens Type-I IFN (IFN-alpha/beta via IFNAR1/TYK2-JAK1) and IL-12/IL-23 signaling, but does NOT block IFN-gamma signaling (which signals exclusively through IFNGR1/IFNGR2 via JAK1 + JAK2, independent of TYK2) nor TNF-alpha / IL-1beta NF-kB/JNK pro-apoptotic signaling, and does NOT prevent host recipient APCs from phagocytosing shed beta-cell autoantigens (PPI, GAD65, IA-2, ZnT8, HIPs) for indirect presentation on recipient HLA-DR3-DQ2 / HLA-DQ8 to autoreactive CD4+ helper T cells.
tyk2_independent_autoimmune_memory_and_i.orthogonal_protection_layers_required: Protection against TYK2-independent IFN-gamma/TNF-alpha + indirect DR3/DQ8 CD4+ autoimmunity relies on: (1) CXCL10-inducible (or L3-BF-B basal-floor) cytosolic SERPINB9 + surface PD-L1 (harnessing local IFN-gamma/STAT1 to upregulate granzyme-B/PD-1 defense), (2) peri-implant SA-FasL / SA-THBD microgel + Treg co-delivery to induce apoptosis of infiltrating Fas+ CD4+ Teff and foster FoxP3+ Treg conversion, and (3) Stage-0 Gate 0C-kinetic verification under combined IFN-gamma + TNF-alpha + IL-1beta + DR3/DQ8 PBMC transwell co-culture.

representative_patient_compilations.plan_b_chr6p21_cis_deletion_hazard_and_s: On GRCh38 chr6p21.3, physical gene order is HLA-A (29.94 Mb) -> HLA-E (30.49 Mb) -> HLA-C (31.27 Mb) -> HLA-B (31.35 Mb); simultaneous DSB multiplexing of HLA-A and HLA-B is prohibited in Plan B due to the ~1.41 Mb interstitial cis-deletion/inversion risk removing intervening HLA-E and retained HLA-C. Requires sequential clonal passes or non-DSB editing plus phased HLA-A/E/C/B ddPCR and OGM verification. Note on HLA-C leader-peptide selection (Lin et al. 2023 Nat Immunol PMID:37264229, PMC10690437, DOI:10.1038/s41590-023-01523-z; AUDIT-REF, Q2-P1..P3, AUDIT-REF, & AUDIT-REF): because HLA-C*07:02 encodes the non-functional SP-3C (VMAPRALLL, carrying P6=Ala [T6A, with P5=Arg]) leader peptide (24.49% of 1000G alleles) that fails to stabilize surface HLA-E, Design B-prime upgrades the C1/C1 sub-bank anchor to functional SP-1C (VMAPRTLIL) HLA-C*01:02 or HLA-C*03:04 (alongside SP-1C C2 anchor HLA-C*04:01) and co-integrates exogenous HLA-E*01:03(SCT) + CD47-IgV-GPI at AAVS1 Locus 4 (subject to physical FASTA materialization and complexity-discount accounting: analytic personalized scenario index is 97.50% unpenalized, 92.84% under K/B complexity discounting vs 92.50% Plan A, and 91.37% unpenalized / 87.65% complexity-discounted if the unmaterialized safe-harbor cloak is omitted; AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF). Note on K/B indexing (AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF [DEC-078]): Layer-5 Track-2 Plan B indexes the 5 DSB/indel loci (HLA-A, HLA-B, CIITA, CXCL10, AAVS1; K=5, B=0 or B=1 with optional TYK2 P1104A PE), whereas Layer-1 Chassis B (ISLET1_B6, global Rank #25, K=6, B=1) indexes 6 DSB/indel loci (HLA-A, HLA-B, CIITA, CXCL10, AAVS1, plus TYK2 knock-out as the 6th DSB/indel locus) and the INS signal-peptide/DRiP base edit as B=1 (and the separate K=5, B=1 TYK2 P1104A prime-edited variant is ISLET1_B2_5LOCUS_TYK2_PE).

clinical_override_warnings: HOLD_TYK2_INDEPENDENT_IFNG_TNFA_AND_INDIRECT_DR3_DQ8_CLEARANCE_REQUIRED: high pre-existing beta-cell autoantigen T-cell reactivity (z = 2.60 >= 2.0) or explicit TYK2-independent IFN-gamma/TNF-alpha + indirect HLA-DR3/DQ8 CD4+ T-cell hazard requires Stage-0 Gate 0D-indirect / Gate 0E-cytokine orthogonal stress clearance (gate0_indirect_dr3_dq8_and_ifng_tnfa_stress_cleared=True) because TYK2 P1104A catalytic attenuation covers Type-I IFN (IFNAR1/2) and IL-12/IL-23 signaling but not JAK1/JAK2-mediated IFN-gamma or recipient APC-mediated indirect CD4+ presentation (AUDIT-REF & AUDIT-REF [DEC-050]).
representative_patient_compilations.track3_autologous_vs_allogeneic_scope_no: In Track 3 (autologous patient iPSC), host-vs-graft alloreactive MHC mismatch is absent, but autoreactive T1D memory CD8+ (PPI/IGRP/ZnT8/GAD65) and CD4+ T-cell protection still requires MHC-I/II + CXCL10::SERPINB9-P2A-PD-L1 or selective autoimmune shielding (AUDIT-REF).
representative_patient_compilations.regulatory_hypothesis_pending_qualified_: Investigational regulatory hypothesis: potential eligibility for FDA Platform Technology Designation (21 U.S.C. 356k, subject to statutory prerequisite of an approved drug/biologic using the platform) or CBER draft/nonbinding Individualized Plausible-Mechanism guidance (Feb 2026) requires formal FDA CBER INTERACT/pre-IND assessment (closing AUDIT-REF).

representative_patient_compilations.plan_architecture_prescribed: Plan A (Core 4-Locus Tri-Modal B2M::HLA-E-CD47-IgV + CIITA-/- + CXCL10::SERPINB9-P2A-PD-L1 + AAVS1-iCasp9)

editing_complexity_and_manufacturing_acc.gate_zero_donor_wgs_and_precloning_junct: Gate 0 (prior to guide lock and HIP-Core clone generation): perform 30x whole-genome sequencing (WGS) + phased HLA/KIR/SIRPA(V1/V2/V8) genotyping of the candidate Master Cell Bank hPSC line to confirm zero PAM/seed SNVs across all 5 guide target windows, followed by Cas-OFFinder + empirical GUIDE-seq/CAST-seq in the actual hPSC line and a pre-cloning T7E1/amplicon-NGS junction re-cleavage assay on synthetic edited-allele amplicons across B2M, CIITA, CXCL10, and AAVS1 (AUDIT-REF & D5-02).
editing_complexity_and_manufacturing_acc.two_pass_clonal_mcb_release_qc_policy: Assigned-rule scenario values in evaluate_regimen_survival_probability are conditioned on a hypothetical release-qualified Master Cell Bank (MCB) clone that has passed two-pass clonal screening (2 chromosomal loci x 2 homologous alleles = 4 target alleles per pass), junction-spanning AAV6 ITR-capture ddPCR (<0.1% vector-backbone/ITR concavemer or off-locus capture at CIITA/CXCL10/AAVS1; Hanlon et al. 2019 PMID:31570731; AUDIT-REF & D6-F03), >=63,000x TP53 duplex-seq (>=62,958 independent duplex molecules), and 20q11.21 ddPCR. Physical uncloned yield is unmeasured. The separate dimensionless engineering utility discount is exp(-lambda_K * max(0, K - 4)) * gamma_B ** B; it is not manufacturing yield or a fitted clinical probability.

host_modifier_genotypes_and_dosing.dosing_model_qualification_note: Illustrative BMI-proportional scaling (500,000 IEQ * BMI / 24.0) or explicit prescribed_dose_ieq override; clinical islet dosing requires actual recipient body weight (kg), baseline insulin requirement, and proportional scaling of pouch exchange area (A = Dose / 2,500 IEQ/cm^2 nominal, or A = Dose / 1,500 IEQ/cm^2 = 333.33 cm^2 at 500,000 total IEQ under DX-B-LowLoad-1500 chronic zero-source encapsulation via modular 100 cm^2 omental cassettes).

tyk2_independent_autoimmune_memory_and_i.tyk2_p1104a_pathway_scope: TYK2 P1104A (rs34536443 C/C) selectively dampens Type-I IFN (IFN-alpha/beta via IFNAR1/TYK2-JAK1) and IL-12/IL-23 signaling, but does NOT block IFN-gamma signaling (which signals exclusively through IFNGR1/IFNGR2 via JAK1 + JAK2, independent of TYK2) nor TNF-alpha / IL-1beta NF-kB/JNK pro-apoptotic signaling, and does NOT prevent host recipient APCs from phagocytosing shed beta-cell autoantigens (PPI, GAD65, IA-2, ZnT8, HIPs) for indirect presentation on recipient HLA-DR3-DQ2 / HLA-DQ8 to autoreactive CD4+ helper T cells.
tyk2_independent_autoimmune_memory_and_i.orthogonal_protection_layers_required: Protection against TYK2-independent IFN-gamma/TNF-alpha + indirect DR3/DQ8 CD4+ autoimmunity relies on: (1) CXCL10-inducible (or L3-BF-B basal-floor) cytosolic SERPINB9 + surface PD-L1 (harnessing local IFN-gamma/STAT1 to upregulate granzyme-B/PD-1 defense), (2) peri-implant SA-FasL / SA-THBD microgel + Treg co-delivery to induce apoptosis of infiltrating Fas+ CD4+ Teff and foster FoxP3+ Treg conversion, and (3) Stage-0 Gate 0C-kinetic verification under combined IFN-gamma + TNF-alpha + IL-1beta + DR3/DQ8 PBMC transwell co-culture.
